+    return f"qrow_{parts[0]}_{parts[1]}_{Path(parts[3]).stem}"

+def paper_metadata(paper_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"9709_([msw])([0-9]{2})_qp_([1-6])([1-5])", paper_id)
+    require(match is not None, "paper_id_invalid")
+    assert match is not None
+    return {
+        "session": match.group(1),
+        "year": 2000 + int(match.group(2)),
+        "paper": int(match.group(3)),
+        "variant": int(match.group(4)),
+    }
+
+
+def era(year: int) -> str:
+    if year <= 2018:
+        return "2016_2018"
+    if year <= 2022:
+        return "2019_2022"
+    return "2023_2025"

+def validate_contract_documents(documents: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    required = set(contract_documents())
+    require(set(documents) == required, "contract_document_set_mismatch")
+    tax = documents["contracts/taxonomy.v0.1.json"]
+    families = tax.get("families", [])
+    require(
+        [item.get("name") for item in families] == list(FAMILIES),
+        "taxonomy_family_set_or_order_invalid",
+    )
+    for family in families:
+        for item in [family, *family.get("types", [])]:
+            for field in (
+                "definition",
+                "inclusion_rules",
+                "exclusion_rules",
+                "positive_examples",
+                "counterexamples",
+                "boundary_cases",
+            ):
+                value = item.get(field)
+                require(
+                    (isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip()))
+                    or (
+                        isinstance(value, list)
+                        and bool(value)
+                        and all(isinstance(entry, str) and entry.strip() for entry in value)
+                    ),
+                    f"taxonomy_required_field_invalid:{item.get('id')}:{field}",
+                )
+    machines = documents["contracts/independent-state-machines.v1.json"]["machines"]
+    require(set(machines) == {"layer_a", "layer_b", "layer_c"}, "state_machine_set_invalid")
+    state_sets = [set(machine["states"]) for machine in machines.values()]
+    require(
+        not state_sets[0] & state_sets[1]
+        and not state_sets[0] & state_sets[2]
+        and not state_sets[1] & state_sets[2],
+        "layer_state_names_not_independent",
+    )
+    require(
+        machines["layer_b"]["agreement_transition"] is None,
+        "agreement_transition_must_be_impossible",
+    )
+    require(
+        documents["contracts/math-9709-adapter.v1.json"]["layer_c_extensions"][
+            "question_level_singleton_factory"
+        ]
+        is False,
+        "question_singleton_factory_enabled",
+    )
+    for name, schema in schema_documents().items():
+        require(schema.get("$schema") == SCHEMA, f"json_schema_draft_missing:{name}")
+        require(schema.get("type") == "object", f"json_schema_root_invalid:{name}")

+def validate_transition(
+    machines: dict[str, Any], layer: str, source: str, target: str, evidence: Iterable[str]
+) -> None:
+    require(layer in machines, "transition_layer_unknown")
+    machine = machines[layer]
+    require(source in machine["states"], "transition_source_unknown")
+    require(target in machine["states"], "transition_target_unknown")
+    require(target in machine["transitions"][source], "transition_not_allowed")
+    required = set(machine.get("approval_evidence", {}).get(target, []))
+    require(required <= set(evidence), "transition_approval_evidence_missing")

+def validate_run_history(runs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    by_id: dict[str, str] = {}
+    parents: dict[str, str | None] = {}
+    for run in runs:
+        run_id = run["run_id"]
+        digest = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes({k: v for k, v in run.items() if k != "digest"}))
+        if run_id in by_id:
+            require(by_id[run_id] == digest, "immutable_run_mutation_rejected")
+        by_id[run_id] = digest
+        parents[run_id] = run.get("supersedes_run_id")
+        require(
+            run.get("mutation_policy") == "append_only_no_historical_overwrite",
+            "run_mutation_policy_invalid",
+        )
+    for run_id, parent in parents.items():
+        if parent is None:
+            continue
+        require(parent in parents, "supersession_predecessor_missing")
+        seen = {run_id}
+        cursor: str | None = parent
+        while cursor is not None:
+            require(cursor not in seen, "supersession_cycle")
+            seen.add(cursor)
+            cursor = parents.get(cursor)

+def validate_contract_documents(documents: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    required = set(contract_documents())
+    require(set(documents) == required, "contract_document_set_mismatch")
+    tax = documents["contracts/taxonomy.v0.1.json"]
+    families = tax.get("families", [])
+    require(
+        [item.get("name") for item in families] == list(FAMILIES),
+        "taxonomy_family_set_or_order_invalid",
+    )
+    for family in families:
+        for item in [family, *family.get("types", [])]:
+            for field in (
+                "definition",
+                "inclusion_rules",
+                "exclusion_rules",
+                "positive_examples",
+                "counterexamples",
+                "boundary_cases",
+            ):
+                value = item.get(field)
+                require(
+                    (isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip()))
+                    or (
+                        isinstance(value, list)
+                        and bool(value)
+                        and all(isinstance(entry, str) and entry.strip() for entry in value)
+                    ),
+                    f"taxonomy_required_field_invalid:{item.get('id')}:{field}",
+                )
+    machines = documents["contracts/independent-state-machines.v1.json"]["machines"]
+    require(set(machines) == {"layer_a", "layer_b", "layer_c"}, "state_machine_set_invalid")
+    state_sets = [set(machine["states"]) for machine in machines.values()]
+    require(
+        not state_sets[0] & state_sets[1]
+        and not state_sets[0] & state_sets[2]
+        and not state_sets[1] & state_sets[2],
+        "layer_state_names_not_independent",
+    )
+    require(
+        machines["layer_b"]["agreement_transition"] is None,
+        "agreement_transition_must_be_impossible",
+    )
+    require(
+        documents["contracts/math-9709-adapter.v1.json"]["layer_c_extensions"][
+            "question_level_singleton_factory"
+        ]
+        is False,
+        "question_singleton_factory_enabled",
+    )
+    for name, schema in schema_documents().items():
+        require(schema.get("$schema") == SCHEMA, f"json_schema_draft_missing:{name}")
+        require(schema.get("type") == "object", f"json_schema_root_invalid:{name}")

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Compare previews against authoritative expected values**

When a preview renders the wrong family, type, procedure references, or citations, it can recompute these hashes from its own incorrect payload and still pass because the validator derives both expected values from the record being validated. It never loads or receives the approved semantic revision and authoritative citation set, while `stale_reference_count` is also self-reported, so the promised exact product readback is only an internal checksum. Supply authoritative expected method-map and citation values and compare the preview against them.

+def validate_contract_documents(documents: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    required = set(contract_documents())
+    require(set(documents) == required, "contract_document_set_mismatch")
+    tax = documents["contracts/taxonomy.v0.1.json"]
+    families = tax.get("families", [])
+    require(
+        [item.get("name") for item in families] == list(FAMILIES),
+        "taxonomy_family_set_or_order_invalid",
+    )
+    for family in families:
+        for item in [family, *family.get("types", [])]:
+            for field in (
+                "definition",
+                "inclusion_rules",
+                "exclusion_rules",
+                "positive_examples",
+                "counterexamples",
+                "boundary_cases",
+            ):
+                value = item.get(field)
+                require(
+                    (isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip()))
+                    or (
+                        isinstance(value, list)
+                        and bool(value)
+                        and all(isinstance(entry, str) and entry.strip() for entry in value)
+                    ),
+                    f"taxonomy_required_field_invalid:{item.get('id')}:{field}",
+                )
+    machines = documents["contracts/independent-state-machines.v1.json"]["machines"]
+    require(set(machines) == {"layer_a", "layer_b", "layer_c"}, "state_machine_set_invalid")
+    state_sets = [set(machine["states"]) for machine in machines.values()]
+    require(
+        not state_sets[0] & state_sets[1]
+        and not state_sets[0] & state_sets[2]
+        and not state_sets[1] & state_sets[2],
+        "layer_state_names_not_independent",
+    )
+    require(
+        machines["layer_b"]["agreement_transition"] is None,
+        "agreement_transition_must_be_impossible",
+    )
+    require(
+        documents["contracts/math-9709-adapter.v1.json"]["layer_c_extensions"][
+            "question_level_singleton_factory"
+        ]
+        is False,
+        "question_singleton_factory_enabled",
+    )
+    for name, schema in schema_documents().items():
+        require(schema.get("$schema") == SCHEMA, f"json_schema_draft_missing:{name}")
+        require(schema.get("type") == "object", f"json_schema_root_invalid:{name}")

+def validate_transition(
+    machines: dict[str, Any], layer: str, source: str, target: str, evidence: Iterable[str]
+) -> None:
+    require(layer in machines, "transition_layer_unknown")
+    machine = machines[layer]
+    require(source in machine["states"], "transition_source_unknown")
+    require(target in machine["states"], "transition_target_unknown")
+    require(target in machine["transitions"][source], "transition_not_allowed")
+    required = set(machine.get("approval_evidence", {}).get(target, []))
+    require(required <= set(evidence), "transition_approval_evidence_missing")

This contradicts the frozen `same_actor_cross_role_auto_approval: false` invariant and allows one actor to populate both roles before approval. Require distinct maker/checker identities and bind the resolver decision to an appropriately separate actor.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject record mutations across superseding runs**

When a successor run reuses an existing `record_id` with a different `content_sha256`, this validator accepts it because immutability is indexed only by `run_id`. Thus `run-v2` can supersede `run-v1` while silently changing the bytes associated with the same record/revision identity, despite the contract requiring a new revision ID and rejection of same-revision mutations. Track record or revision identities and reject conflicting content hashes across the entire run history.

+class ContractError(RuntimeError):

+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def write_json(path: Path, value: Any, mode: int = 0o644) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    data = canonical_bytes(value)
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, delete=False) as handle:
+        temporary = Path(handle.name)
+        handle.write(data)
+        handle.flush()
+        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+    os.chmod(temporary, mode)
+    os.replace(temporary, path)
+
+
+def require(condition: bool, code: str) -> None:
+    if not condition:
+        raise ContractError(code)
+
+
+def stable_score(seed: str, *parts: str) -> str:
+    return sha256_bytes("\x1f".join((seed, *parts)).encode("utf-8"))
+

+def qid_from_text_item(item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    parts = item["storage_key"].split("/")
+    require(
+        len(parts) == 4 and parts[0] == "9709" and parts[2] == "questions",
+        "text_hint_storage_key_invalid",
+    )
+    return f"qrow_{parts[0]}_{parts[1]}_{Path(parts[3]).stem}"

+def paper_metadata(paper_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"9709_([msw])([0-9]{2})_qp_([1-6])([1-5])", paper_id)
+    require(match is not None, "paper_id_invalid")
+    assert match is not None
+    return {
+        "session": match.group(1),
+        "year": 2000 + int(match.group(2)),
+        "paper": int(match.group(3)),
+        "variant": int(match.group(4)),
+    }

+def validate_contract_documents(documents: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    required = set(contract_documents())
+    require(set(documents) == required, "contract_document_set_mismatch")
+    tax = documents["contracts/taxonomy.v0.1.json"]
+    families = tax.get("families", [])
+    require(
+        [item.get("name") for item in families] == list(FAMILIES),
+        "taxonomy_family_set_or_order_invalid",
+    )
+    for family in families:
+        for item in [family, *family.get("types", [])]:
+            for field in (
+                "definition",
+                "inclusion_rules",
+                "exclusion_rules",
+                "positive_examples",
+                "counterexamples",
+                "boundary_cases",
+            ):
+                value = item.get(field)
+                require(
+                    (isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip()))
+                    or (
+                        isinstance(value, list)
+                        and bool(value)
+                        and all(isinstance(entry, str) and entry.strip() for entry in value)
+                    ),
+                    f"taxonomy_required_field_invalid:{item.get('id')}:{field}",
+                )
+    machines = documents["contracts/independent-state-machines.v1.json"]["machines"]
+    require(set(machines) == {"layer_a", "layer_b", "layer_c"}, "state_machine_set_invalid")
+    state_sets = [set(machine["states"]) for machine in machines.values()]
+    require(
+        not state_sets[0] & state_sets[1]
+        and not state_sets[0] & state_sets[2]
+        and not state_sets[1] & state_sets[2],
+        "layer_state_names_not_independent",
+    )
+    require(
+        machines["layer_b"]["agreement_transition"] is None,
+        "agreement_transition_must_be_impossible",
+    )
+    require(
+        documents["contracts/math-9709-adapter.v1.json"]["layer_c_extensions"][
+            "question_level_singleton_factory"
+        ]
+        is False,
+        "question_singleton_factory_enabled",
+    )
+    for name, schema in schema_documents().items():
+        require(schema.get("$schema") == SCHEMA, f"json_schema_draft_missing:{name}")

+def validate_run_history(runs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    by_id: dict[str, str] = {}
+    parents: dict[str, str | None] = {}
+    for run in runs:
+        run_id = run["run_id"]
+        digest = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes({k: v for k, v in run.items() if k != "digest"}))
+        if run_id in by_id:
+            require(by_id[run_id] == digest, "immutable_run_mutation_rejected")
+        by_id[run_id] = digest
+        parents[run_id] = run.get("supersedes_run_id")
+        require(
+            run.get("mutation_policy") == "append_only_no_historical_overwrite",
+            "run_mutation_policy_invalid",
+        )
+    for run_id, parent in parents.items():
+        if parent is None:
+            continue
+        require(parent in parents, "supersession_predecessor_missing")
+        seen = {run_id}
+        cursor: str | None = parent
+        while cursor is not None:
+            require(cursor not in seen, "supersession_cycle")
+            seen.add(cursor)
+            cursor = parents.get(cursor)

+def candidate_descriptor(
+    family: str, qid: str, row: dict[str, Any], hint: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    question = row["question"]
+    paper_id = question["paper_id"]
+    meta = paper_metadata(paper_id)
+    pages = question["complete_page_chain"]
+    regions = question["authoritative_regions"]
+    normalized_text = hint.get("normalized_plain_text", "")
+    explicit_alternative = bool(
+        re.search(
+            r"\bor otherwise\b|\bor by another method\b|\balternative method\b",
+            normalized_text,
+            re.IGNORECASE,
+        )
+    )
+    linked_method = bool(
+        re.search(
+            r"\bshow that\b|\bprove that\b|\bhence\b|\busing the substitution\b",
+            normalized_text,
+            re.IGNORECASE,
+        )
+    )
+    boundary_patterns = {
+        "Integration Techniques": (
+            r"dy/dx|\\frac\{\\mathrm\{d\}y\}|"
+            r"\barea\b|\bvolume\b|\bsin\b|\bcos\b|\btan\b"
+        ),
+        "Differential Equations": (
+            r"\btank\b|\bpopulation\b|\bproportion|\brate\b|\bmodel\b|"
+            r"\bwhen x\b|\bwhen t\b|\bwhen y\b"
+        ),
+        "Trigonometric Manipulation / Equations": (
+            r"\bshow that\b|\bprove\b|\btriangle\b|\bidentity\b|"
+            r"\bdifferentiat|\bintegrat"
+        ),
+    }
+    boundary_candidate = bool(
+        re.search(boundary_patterns.get(family, r"$a"), normalized_text, re.IGNORECASE)
+    )
+    require(bool(regions), "selected_question_authoritative_regions_missing")
+    return {
+        "question_id": qid,
+        "paper_id": paper_id,
+        "family_reservation": family,
+        "topic_hint": hint["primary_topic_path"],
+        "topic_hint_role": "selection_only_not_semantic_approval",
+        "structural_verification_state": question["verification_state"],
+        "structural_record_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(row)),
+        "source_binding_summary": [
+            {
+                "semantic_role": "structural_selection_authority",
+                "source_object_id": region["source_object_id"],
+                "source_sha256": region["source_sha256"],
+                "page_number": region["page_number"],
+                "region_id": region["region_id"],
+                "region_sha256": region["crop_sha256"],
+            }
+            for region in regions
+        ],
+        "selection_facets": {
+            **meta,
+            "era": era(meta["year"]),
+            "page_shape": "cross_page" if len(pages) > 1 else "single_page",
+            "layout_family": question["layout_family"],
+        },
+        "reservation_hints": {
+            "hint_role": "selection_only_stage_2_must_independently_confirm",
+            "explicit_alternative_wording": explicit_alternative,
+            "alternative_path_review_candidate": explicit_alternative
+            or linked_method,
+            "single_path_review_candidate": not (explicit_alternative or linked_method),
+            "taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate": boundary_candidate,
+        },
+        "semantic_processing_executed": False,
+    }
+

+def core_candidates(

+) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+    for qid, hint in hints.items():

+def select_family(
+    candidates: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    count: int,
+    seed: str,
+    label: str,
+    used_papers: set[str],
+    coverage: bool,
+    preferred_papers: set[str] | None = None,
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    available = [
+        row
+        for row in ranked(candidates, seed, label)
+        if row["paper_id"] not in used_papers
+    ]
+    preferred_papers = preferred_papers or set()
+    available.sort(
+        key=lambda row: (
+            0 if row["paper_id"] in preferred_papers else 1,
+            stable_score(seed, label, row["question_id"]),
+            row["question_id"],
+        )
+    )
+    selected: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def take(predicate: Any, code: str) -> None:
+        for row in available:
+            if row in selected or row["paper_id"] in used_papers:
+                continue
+            if predicate(row):
+                selected.append(row)
+                used_papers.add(row["paper_id"])
+                return
+        raise ContractError(f"insufficient_coverage:{label}:{code}")
+
+    if coverage:
+        for session in ("m", "s", "w"):
+            take(
+                lambda row, value=session: row["selection_facets"]["session"] == value,
+                f"session_{session}",
+            )
+        for era_name in ("2016_2018", "2019_2022", "2023_2025"):
+            take(
+                lambda row, value=era_name: row["selection_facets"]["era"] == value,
+                f"era_{era_name}",
+            )
+        for shape in ("single_page", "cross_page"):
+            take(
+                lambda row, value=shape: row["selection_facets"]["page_shape"] == value,
+                f"page_shape_{shape}",
+            )
+        for index in range(2):
+            take(
+                lambda row: row["reservation_hints"][
+                    "alternative_path_review_candidate"
+                ],
+                f"alternative_path_review_candidate_{index + 1}",
+            )
+        for index in range(2):
+            take(
+                lambda row: row["reservation_hints"]["single_path_review_candidate"],
+                f"single_path_review_candidate_{index + 1}",
+            )
+        for index in range(2):
+            take(
+                lambda row: row["reservation_hints"][
+                    "taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate"
+                ],
+                f"taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate_{index + 1}",
+            )
+        if label != "Differential Equations":
+            for paper in (1, 3):
+                take(
+                    lambda row, value=paper: row["selection_facets"]["paper"] == value,
+                    f"paper_{paper}",
+                )
+    for row in available:
+        if len(selected) == count:
+            break
+        if row in selected or row["paper_id"] in used_papers:
+            continue
+        selected.append(row)
+        used_papers.add(row["paper_id"])
+    require(len(selected) == count, f"insufficient_family_count:{label}")
+    return sorted(selected, key=lambda row: row["question_id"])
+

+def ensure_private_key(private_root: Path) -> tuple[Path, bytes]:
+    private_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    os.chmod(private_root, 0o700)
+    key_path = private_root / "sealed-holdout-hmac.key"
+    if key_path.exists():
+        mode = stat.S_IMODE(key_path.stat().st_mode)
+        require(mode == 0o600, "sealed_key_permissions_invalid")
+        key = key_path.read_bytes()
+        require(len(key) == 32, "sealed_key_length_invalid")
+        return key_path, key
+    key = secrets.token_bytes(32)
+    descriptor = os.open(key_path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
+    with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as handle:
+        handle.write(key)
+        handle.flush()
+        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+    return key_path, key
+

+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    members: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

+        "commitment": {

+            "question_token_merkle_root": merkle_root(question_tokens),
+            "paper_token_merkle_root": merkle_root(paper_tokens),

+        "paper_ids": {row["paper_id"] for row in members},
+        "membership_hmac_sha256": membership_hmac,

+    return commitment, private_receipt

+def merkle_root(tokens: list[str]) -> str:
+    require(bool(tokens), "merkle_tree_empty")
+    level = [bytes.fromhex(token) for token in tokens]
+    while len(level) > 1:
+        if len(level) % 2:
+            level.append(level[-1])
+        level = [
+            hashlib.sha256(level[index] + level[index + 1]).digest()
+            for index in range(0, len(level), 2)
+        ]
+    return level[0].hex()
+

+            members

+                members,

+                    row["family_reservation"],
+                    row["question_id"],
+                ),

+            f"{partition}_member_order_drift",
+        )
+        for member in members:
+            qid = member["question_id"]
+            require(qid not in rejected, "safe_rejection_in_public_selection")
+            require(qid in eligible, f"{partition}_member_ineligible")
+            require(qid in hints, f"{partition}_topic_hint_missing")
+            family = member["family_reservation"]
+            if family in FAMILIES:
+                require(
+                    hints[qid]["primary_topic_path"] in FAMILY_TOPIC_HINTS[family],
+                    f"{partition}_family_topic_hint_mismatch",
+                )
+                expected = candidate_descriptor(family, qid, eligible[qid], hints[qid])
+            else:
+                match = re.fullmatch(r"adapter_stress_p([456])", family)
+                require(match is not None, f"{partition}_stratum_invalid")
+                require(
+                    int(hints[qid]["paper"]) == int(match.group(1)),
+                    f"{partition}_adapter_paper_mismatch",
+                )
+                expected = candidate_descriptor(family, qid, eligible[qid], hints[qid])
+                expected["allowed_terminal_posture"] = [
+                    "taxonomy_review_required",
+                    "adapter_extension_required",
+                    "out_of_current_scope",
+                ]
+            require(member == expected, f"{partition}_member_authority_hash_drift")
+
+    validate_public_members(walking, "walking")
+    validate_public_members(calibration, "calibration")
+    walking_q, walking_p = public_member_sets(walking)
+    calibration_q, calibration_p = public_member_sets(calibration)
+    require(len(walking_q) == 48, "walking_duplicate_or_count_invalid")
+    require(len(calibration_q) == 120, "calibration_duplicate_or_count_invalid")
+    require(walking_q.isdisjoint(calibration_q), "walking_calibration_question_overlap")
+    require(walking_p.isdisjoint(calibration_p), "walking_calibration_group_leakage")
+    require(not (walking_q | calibration_q) & rejected, "safe_rejection_in_public_selection")
+    require(walking_q | calibration_q <= set(eligible), "ineligible_public_selection")
+    require(
+        walking["family_counts"] == {family: 16 for family in sorted(FAMILIES)},
+        "walking_family_counts_invalid",
+    )
+    require(
+        calibration["family_counts"]
+        == {

+            "Integration Techniques": 30,
+            "Trigonometric Manipulation / Equations": 30,
+            "adapter_stress_p4": 10,
+            "adapter_stress_p5": 10,

+        "calibration_stratum_counts_invalid",

+    require(

+    require(walking["semantic_processing_executed"] is False, "walking_executed")
+    require(calibration["semantic_processing_executed"] is False, "calibration_executed")
+    require(

+    require(

+    require(sealed.get("membership_disclosed") is False, "sealed_disclosure_invalid")
+    require(sealed.get("membership_inspected") is False, "sealed_inspection_invalid")
+    require(sealed.get("semantic_processing_executed") is False, "sealed_executed")
+    public_text = canonical_bytes(sealed).decode("utf-8")
+    require("qrow_9709_" not in public_text, "sealed_question_plaintext_public")
+    require(re.search(r"9709_[msw][0-9]{2}_qp_", public_text) is None, "sealed_paper_plaintext_public")
+    overlap = {

+        "walking_sealed_question_overlap": 0,
+        "walking_sealed_paper_overlap": 0,
+        "calibration_sealed_question_overlap": 0,
+        "calibration_sealed_paper_overlap": 0,

+    if private_receipt is not None:

+    coverage = walking["coverage"]["by_family"]

+def validate_public_artifacts(output_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    manifest_path = output_root / "artifact-manifest.v1.json"
+    require(manifest_path.exists(), "artifact_manifest_missing")
+    manifest = load_json(manifest_path)
+    entries = manifest.get("entries", [])
+    require(
+        manifest.get("entry_count") == len(entries),
+        "artifact_manifest_entry_count_drift",
+    )
+    declared: set[str] = set()
+    for entry in entries:
+        relative = entry.get("path")
+        require(isinstance(relative, str) and bool(relative), "manifest_path_invalid")
+        candidate = Path(relative)
+        require(
+            not candidate.is_absolute() and ".." not in candidate.parts,
+            "manifest_path_escapes_output_root",
+        )
+        require(relative not in declared, "artifact_manifest_duplicate_path")
+        declared.add(relative)
+        path = output_root / candidate
+        require(path.is_file(), f"manifest_artifact_missing:{relative}")
+        require(
+            sha256_file(path) == entry.get("sha256"),
+            f"manifest_hash_drift:{relative}",
+        )
+        require(
+            path.stat().st_size == entry.get("byte_length"),
+            f"manifest_size_drift:{relative}",
+        )
+    actual = {
+        path.relative_to(output_root).as_posix()
+        for path in output_root.rglob("*.json")
+        if path != manifest_path
+    }
+    require(actual == declared, "artifact_manifest_file_set_drift")
+    documents = {

When a bundle's gate receipt has an empty or incomplete `checks` array, `all(...)` is vacuously true and `--validate-only` accepts it as long as the top-level status says `pass`. This allows a malformed gate that omits critical checks such as leakage or mutation rejection to validate successfully; the unit test checks the current fixture's length, but the runtime validator does not protect other bundles. Compare the check names and count against the exact required 17-check set before accepting the gate.

+class ContractError(RuntimeError):
+    """Fail-closed validation error."""

+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return (
+        json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2).encode("utf-8")
+        + b"\n"
+    )
+
+
+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def write_json(path: Path, value: Any, mode: int = 0o644) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    data = canonical_bytes(value)
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, delete=False) as handle:
+        temporary = Path(handle.name)
+        handle.write(data)
+        handle.flush()
+        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+    os.chmod(temporary, mode)
+    os.replace(temporary, path)
+
+
+def require(condition: bool, code: str) -> None:
+    if not condition:
+        raise ContractError(code)
+
+
+def stable_score(seed: str, *parts: str) -> str:
+    return sha256_bytes("\x1f".join((seed, *parts)).encode("utf-8"))
+
+
+def qid_from_text_item(item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    parts = item["storage_key"].split("/")
+    require(
+        len(parts) == 4 and parts[0] == "9709" and parts[2] == "questions",
+        "text_hint_storage_key_invalid",
+    )
+    return f"qrow_{parts[0]}_{parts[1]}_{Path(parts[3]).stem}"
+

+def paper_metadata(paper_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"9709_([msw])([0-9]{2})_qp_([1-6])([1-5])", paper_id)
+    require(match is not None, "paper_id_invalid")
+    assert match is not None
+    return {
+        "session": match.group(1),
+        "year": 2000 + int(match.group(2)),
+        "paper": int(match.group(3)),
+        "variant": int(match.group(4)),
+    }
+
+
+def era(year: int) -> str:
+    if year <= 2018:
+        return "2016_2018"
+    if year <= 2022:
+        return "2019_2022"
+    return "2023_2025"

+def validate_contract_documents(documents: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    required = set(contract_documents())
+    require(set(documents) == required, "contract_document_set_mismatch")
+    tax = documents["contracts/taxonomy.v0.1.json"]
+    families = tax.get("families", [])
+    require(
+        [item.get("name") for item in families] == list(FAMILIES),
+        "taxonomy_family_set_or_order_invalid",
+    )
+    for family in families:
+        for item in [family, *family.get("types", [])]:
+            for field in (
+                "definition",
+                "inclusion_rules",
+                "exclusion_rules",
+                "positive_examples",
+                "counterexamples",
+                "boundary_cases",
+            ):
+                value = item.get(field)
+                require(
+                    (isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip()))
+                    or (
+                        isinstance(value, list)
+                        and bool(value)
+                        and all(isinstance(entry, str) and entry.strip() for entry in value)
+                    ),
+                    f"taxonomy_required_field_invalid:{item.get('id')}:{field}",
+                )
+    machines = documents["contracts/independent-state-machines.v1.json"]["machines"]
+    require(set(machines) == {"layer_a", "layer_b", "layer_c"}, "state_machine_set_invalid")
+    state_sets = [set(machine["states"]) for machine in machines.values()]
+    require(
+        not state_sets[0] & state_sets[1]
+        and not state_sets[0] & state_sets[2]
+        and not state_sets[1] & state_sets[2],
+        "layer_state_names_not_independent",
+    )
+    require(
+        machines["layer_b"]["agreement_transition"] is None,
+        "agreement_transition_must_be_impossible",
+    )
+    require(
+        documents["contracts/math-9709-adapter.v1.json"]["layer_c_extensions"][
+            "question_level_singleton_factory"
+        ]
+        is False,
+        "question_singleton_factory_enabled",
+    )
+    for name, schema in schema_documents().items():
+        require(schema.get("$schema") == SCHEMA, f"json_schema_draft_missing:{name}")
+        require(schema.get("type") == "object", f"json_schema_root_invalid:{name}")

+def validate_run_history(runs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    by_id: dict[str, str] = {}
+    parents: dict[str, str | None] = {}
+    for run in runs:
+        run_id = run["run_id"]
+        digest = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes({k: v for k, v in run.items() if k != "digest"}))
+        if run_id in by_id:
+            require(by_id[run_id] == digest, "immutable_run_mutation_rejected")
+        by_id[run_id] = digest
+        parents[run_id] = run.get("supersedes_run_id")
+        require(
+            run.get("mutation_policy") == "append_only_no_historical_overwrite",
+            "run_mutation_policy_invalid",
+        )
+    for run_id, parent in parents.items():
+        if parent is None:
+            continue
+        require(parent in parents, "supersession_predecessor_missing")
+        seen = {run_id}
+        cursor: str | None = parent
+        while cursor is not None:
+            require(cursor not in seen, "supersession_cycle")
+            seen.add(cursor)
+            cursor = parents.get(cursor)

+def candidate_descriptor(
+    family: str, qid: str, row: dict[str, Any], hint: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    question = row["question"]
+    paper_id = question["paper_id"]
+    meta = paper_metadata(paper_id)
+    pages = question["complete_page_chain"]
+    regions = question["authoritative_regions"]
+    normalized_text = hint.get("normalized_plain_text", "")
+    explicit_alternative = bool(
+        re.search(
+            r"\bor otherwise\b|\bor by another method\b|\balternative method\b",
+            normalized_text,
+            re.IGNORECASE,
+        )
+    )
+    linked_method = bool(
+        re.search(
+            r"\bshow that\b|\bprove that\b|\bhence\b|\busing the substitution\b",
+            normalized_text,
+            re.IGNORECASE,
+        )
+    )
+    boundary_patterns = {
+        "Integration Techniques": (
+            r"dy/dx|\\frac\{\\mathrm\{d\}y\}|"
+            r"\barea\b|\bvolume\b|\bsin\b|\bcos\b|\btan\b"
+        ),
+        "Differential Equations": (
+            r"\btank\b|\bpopulation\b|\bproportion|\brate\b|\bmodel\b|"
+            r"\bwhen x\b|\bwhen t\b|\bwhen y\b"
+        ),
+        "Trigonometric Manipulation / Equations": (
+            r"\bshow that\b|\bprove\b|\btriangle\b|\bidentity\b|"
+            r"\bdifferentiat|\bintegrat"
+        ),
+    }
+    boundary_candidate = bool(
+        re.search(boundary_patterns.get(family, r"$a"), normalized_text, re.IGNORECASE)
+    )
+    require(bool(regions), "selected_question_authoritative_regions_missing")
+    return {
+        "question_id": qid,
+        "paper_id": paper_id,
+        "family_reservation": family,
+        "topic_hint": hint["primary_topic_path"],
+        "topic_hint_role": "selection_only_not_semantic_approval",
+        "structural_verification_state": question["verification_state"],
+        "structural_record_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(row)),
+        "source_binding_summary": [
+            {
+                "semantic_role": "structural_selection_authority",
+                "source_object_id": region["source_object_id"],
+                "source_sha256": region["source_sha256"],
+                "page_number": region["page_number"],
+                "region_id": region["region_id"],
+                "region_sha256": region["crop_sha256"],
+            }
+            for region in regions
+        ],
+        "selection_facets": {
+            **meta,
+            "era": era(meta["year"]),
+            "page_shape": "cross_page" if len(pages) > 1 else "single_page",
+            "layout_family": question["layout_family"],
+        },
+        "reservation_hints": {
+            "hint_role": "selection_only_stage_2_must_independently_confirm",
+            "explicit_alternative_wording": explicit_alternative,
+            "alternative_path_review_candidate": explicit_alternative
+            or linked_method,
+            "single_path_review_candidate": not (explicit_alternative or linked_method),
+            "taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate": boundary_candidate,
+        },
+        "semantic_processing_executed": False,
+    }

+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

+def select_family(
+    candidates: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    count: int,
+    seed: str,
+    label: str,
+    used_papers: set[str],
+    coverage: bool,
+    preferred_papers: set[str] | None = None,
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    available = [
+        row
+        for row in ranked(candidates, seed, label)
+        if row["paper_id"] not in used_papers
+    ]
+    preferred_papers = preferred_papers or set()
+    available.sort(
+        key=lambda row: (
+            0 if row["paper_id"] in preferred_papers else 1,
+            stable_score(seed, label, row["question_id"]),
+            row["question_id"],
+        )
+    )
+    selected: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def take(predicate: Any, code: str) -> None:
+        for row in available:
+            if row in selected or row["paper_id"] in used_papers:
+                continue
+            if predicate(row):
+                selected.append(row)
+                used_papers.add(row["paper_id"])
+                return
+        raise ContractError(f"insufficient_coverage:{label}:{code}")
+
+    if coverage:
+        for session in ("m", "s", "w"):
+            take(
+                lambda row, value=session: row["selection_facets"]["session"] == value,
+                f"session_{session}",
+            )
+        for era_name in ("2016_2018", "2019_2022", "2023_2025"):
+            take(
+                lambda row, value=era_name: row["selection_facets"]["era"] == value,
+                f"era_{era_name}",
+            )
+        for shape in ("single_page", "cross_page"):
+            take(
+                lambda row, value=shape: row["selection_facets"]["page_shape"] == value,
+                f"page_shape_{shape}",
+            )
+        for index in range(2):
+            take(
+                lambda row: row["reservation_hints"][
+                    "alternative_path_review_candidate"
+                ],
+                f"alternative_path_review_candidate_{index + 1}",
+            )
+        for index in range(2):
+            take(
+                lambda row: row["reservation_hints"]["single_path_review_candidate"],
+                f"single_path_review_candidate_{index + 1}",
+            )
+        for index in range(2):
+            take(
+                lambda row: row["reservation_hints"][
+                    "taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate"
+                ],
+                f"taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate_{index + 1}",
+            )
+        if label != "Differential Equations":
+            for paper in (1, 3):
+                take(
+                    lambda row, value=paper: row["selection_facets"]["paper"] == value,
+                    f"paper_{paper}",
+                )
+    for row in available:
+        if len(selected) == count:
+            break
+        if row in selected or row["paper_id"] in used_papers:
+            continue
+        selected.append(row)
+        used_papers.add(row["paper_id"])
+    require(len(selected) == count, f"insufficient_family_count:{label}")

+    result: dict[int, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {4: [], 5: [], 6: []}
+    for qid, hint in hints.items():

+def ensure_private_key(private_root: Path) -> tuple[Path, bytes]:
+    private_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    os.chmod(private_root, 0o700)
+    key_path = private_root / "sealed-holdout-hmac.key"
+    if key_path.exists():
+        mode = stat.S_IMODE(key_path.stat().st_mode)
+        require(mode == 0o600, "sealed_key_permissions_invalid")
+        key = key_path.read_bytes()
+        require(len(key) == 32, "sealed_key_length_invalid")
+        return key_path, key
+    key = secrets.token_bytes(32)
+    descriptor = os.open(key_path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
+    with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as handle:
+        handle.write(key)
+        handle.flush()
+        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+    return key_path, key
+

+    members: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

+        for row in members

+        for row in members

+        "membership_disclosed": False,
+        "membership_inspected": False,
+        "semantic_processing_executed": False,
+        "commitment": {
+            "algorithm": "HMAC-SHA-256",
+            "membership_hmac_sha256": membership_hmac,
+            "question_token_merkle_root": merkle_root(question_tokens),
+            "paper_token_merkle_root": merkle_root(paper_tokens),
+            "key_id_sha256": sha256_bytes(key),

+        "question_ids": {row["question_id"] for row in members},
+        "paper_ids": {row["paper_id"] for row in members},
+        "membership_hmac_sha256": membership_hmac,

+    return commitment, private_receipt

+def merkle_root(tokens: list[str]) -> str:
+    require(bool(tokens), "merkle_tree_empty")
+    level = [bytes.fromhex(token) for token in tokens]
+    while len(level) > 1:
+        if len(level) % 2:
+            level.append(level[-1])
+        level = [
+            hashlib.sha256(level[index] + level[index + 1]).digest()
+            for index in range(0, len(level), 2)
+        ]
+    return level[0].hex()
+

+def validate_selections(
+    walking: dict[str, Any],
+    calibration: dict[str, Any],
+    sealed: dict[str, Any],
+    private_receipt: dict[str, Any] | None,
+    eligible: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    hints: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    rejected: set[str],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    def validate_public_members(document: dict[str, Any], partition: str) -> None:
+        members = document.get("members", [])
+        require(
+            members
+            == sorted(
+                members,
+                key=lambda row: (
+                    row["family_reservation"],
+                    row["question_id"],
+                ),
+            ),
+            f"{partition}_member_order_drift",
+        )
+        for member in members:
+            qid = member["question_id"]
+            require(qid not in rejected, "safe_rejection_in_public_selection")
+            require(qid in eligible, f"{partition}_member_ineligible")
+            require(qid in hints, f"{partition}_topic_hint_missing")
+            family = member["family_reservation"]
+            if family in FAMILIES:
+                require(
+                    hints[qid]["primary_topic_path"] in FAMILY_TOPIC_HINTS[family],
+                    f"{partition}_family_topic_hint_mismatch",
+                )
+                expected = candidate_descriptor(family, qid, eligible[qid], hints[qid])
+            else:
+                match = re.fullmatch(r"adapter_stress_p([456])", family)
+                require(match is not None, f"{partition}_stratum_invalid")
+                require(
+                    int(hints[qid]["paper"]) == int(match.group(1)),
+                    f"{partition}_adapter_paper_mismatch",
+                )
+                expected = candidate_descriptor(family, qid, eligible[qid], hints[qid])
+                expected["allowed_terminal_posture"] = [
+                    "taxonomy_review_required",
+                    "adapter_extension_required",
+                    "out_of_current_scope",
+                ]
+            require(member == expected, f"{partition}_member_authority_hash_drift")
+
+    validate_public_members(walking, "walking")
+    validate_public_members(calibration, "calibration")
+    walking_q, walking_p = public_member_sets(walking)
+    calibration_q, calibration_p = public_member_sets(calibration)
+    require(len(walking_q) == 48, "walking_duplicate_or_count_invalid")
+    require(len(calibration_q) == 120, "calibration_duplicate_or_count_invalid")
+    require(walking_q.isdisjoint(calibration_q), "walking_calibration_question_overlap")
+    require(walking_p.isdisjoint(calibration_p), "walking_calibration_group_leakage")
+    require(not (walking_q | calibration_q) & rejected, "safe_rejection_in_public_selection")
+    require(walking_q | calibration_q <= set(eligible), "ineligible_public_selection")
+    require(
+        walking["family_counts"] == {family: 16 for family in sorted(FAMILIES)},
+        "walking_family_counts_invalid",
+    )
+    require(
+        calibration["family_counts"]
+        == {
+            "Differential Equations": 30,
+            "Integration Techniques": 30,
+            "Trigonometric Manipulation / Equations": 30,
+            "adapter_stress_p4": 10,
+            "adapter_stress_p5": 10,
+            "adapter_stress_p6": 10,
+        },
+        "calibration_stratum_counts_invalid",
+    )
+    require(
+        calibration.get("core_family_count") == 90
+        and calibration.get("adapter_stress_count") == 30,
+        "calibration_core_stress_counts_invalid",
+    )
+    require(walking["semantic_processing_executed"] is False, "walking_executed")
+    require(calibration["semantic_processing_executed"] is False, "calibration_executed")
+    require(
+        calibration["status"] == "membership_frozen_execution_gated",
+        "calibration_gate_missing",
+    )
+    require(sealed.get("member_count") == 48, "sealed_count_invalid")
+    require(
+        sealed.get("family_counts")
+        == {family: 16 for family in sorted(FAMILIES)},
+        "sealed_family_counts_invalid",
+    )
+    require(sealed.get("membership_disclosed") is False, "sealed_disclosure_invalid")
+    require(sealed.get("membership_inspected") is False, "sealed_inspection_invalid")
+    require(sealed.get("semantic_processing_executed") is False, "sealed_executed")
+    public_text = canonical_bytes(sealed).decode("utf-8")
+    require("qrow_9709_" not in public_text, "sealed_question_plaintext_public")
+    require(re.search(r"9709_[msw][0-9]{2}_qp_", public_text) is None, "sealed_paper_plaintext_public")
+    overlap = {
+        "walking_calibration_question_overlap": len(walking_q & calibration_q),
+        "walking_calibration_paper_overlap": len(walking_p & calibration_p),
+        "walking_sealed_question_overlap": 0,
+        "walking_sealed_paper_overlap": 0,
+        "calibration_sealed_question_overlap": 0,
+        "calibration_sealed_paper_overlap": 0,
+    }
+    if private_receipt is not None:
+        sealed_q = private_receipt["question_ids"]
+        sealed_p = private_receipt["paper_ids"]
+        require(len(sealed_q) == 48, "sealed_private_duplicate_or_count_invalid")
+        require(sealed_q <= set(eligible), "ineligible_sealed_selection")
+        require(not sealed_q & rejected, "safe_rejection_in_sealed_selection")
+        overlap.update(
+            {
+                "walking_sealed_question_overlap": len(walking_q & sealed_q),
+                "walking_sealed_paper_overlap": len(walking_p & sealed_p),
+                "calibration_sealed_question_overlap": len(calibration_q & sealed_q),
+                "calibration_sealed_paper_overlap": len(calibration_p & sealed_p),

+        )
+        require(all(value == 0 for value in overlap.values()), "partition_group_leakage")
+        require(
+            private_receipt["membership_hmac_sha256"]
+            == sealed["commitment"]["membership_hmac_sha256"],
+            "sealed_private_commitment_mismatch",
+        )
+    require(all(value == 0 for value in overlap.values()), "public_partition_leakage")
+    coverage = walking["coverage"]["by_family"]
+    for family in FAMILIES:
+        value = coverage[family]
+        require(value["count"] == 16, f"walking_coverage_count:{family}")
+        require(value["sessions"] == ["m", "s", "w"], f"walking_session_coverage:{family}")
+        require(

+        )
+        require(
+            value["page_shapes"] == ["cross_page", "single_page"],

+        require(

+        )
+        require(
+            value["single_path_review_candidate_count"] >= 2,
+            f"walking_single_path_reservation:{family}",
+        )
+        require(
+            value["taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate_count"] >= 2,
+            f"walking_taxonomy_boundary_reservation:{family}",

+    require(
+        set(coverage["Integration Techniques"]["papers"]) == {"P1", "P3"},
+        "walking_integration_paper_coverage",
+    )
+    require(
+        set(coverage["Trigonometric Manipulation / Equations"]["papers"])
+        == {"P1", "P3"},

+        "ineligible_membership_count": 0,

+        "sealed_membership_content_inspected": False,

+def validate_public_artifacts(output_root: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    manifest_path = output_root / "artifact-manifest.v1.json"
+    require(manifest_path.exists(), "artifact_manifest_missing")
+    manifest = load_json(manifest_path)
+    entries = manifest.get("entries", [])
+    require(
+        manifest.get("entry_count") == len(entries),
+        "artifact_manifest_entry_count_drift",
+    )
+    declared: set[str] = set()
+    for entry in entries:
+        relative = entry.get("path")
+        require(isinstance(relative, str) and bool(relative), "manifest_path_invalid")
+        candidate = Path(relative)
+        require(
+            not candidate.is_absolute() and ".." not in candidate.parts,
+            "manifest_path_escapes_output_root",
+        )
+        require(relative not in declared, "artifact_manifest_duplicate_path")
+        declared.add(relative)
+        path = output_root / candidate
+        require(path.is_file(), f"manifest_artifact_missing:{relative}")
+        require(
+            sha256_file(path) == entry.get("sha256"),
+            f"manifest_hash_drift:{relative}",
+        )
+        require(
+            path.stat().st_size == entry.get("byte_length"),
+            f"manifest_size_drift:{relative}",
+        )
+    actual = {
+        path.relative_to(output_root).as_posix()
+        for path in output_root.rglob("*.json")
+        if path != manifest_path
+    }
+    require(actual == declared, "artifact_manifest_file_set_drift")
+    documents = {
+        relative: load_json(output_root / relative) for relative in contract_documents()
+    }
+    validate_contract_documents(documents)
+    walking = load_json(output_root / "selections/walking-selection.v1.json")
+    calibration = load_json(output_root / "selections/calibration-selection.v1.json")
+    sealed = load_json(output_root / "selections/sealed-holdout-commitment.v1.json")
+    leakage = load_json(output_root / "selections/group-leakage-audit.v1.json")
+    eligible, hints, rejected, authority = build_candidate_rows()
+    computed = validate_selections(
+        walking, calibration, sealed, None, eligible, hints, rejected
+    )
+    authority_doc = load_json(output_root / "authority/input-authority.v1.json")
+    for key, value in authority.items():
+        require(
+            authority_doc.get(key) == value,
+            f"input_authority_drift:{key}",
+        )
+    require(
+        authority_doc.get("starting_main_sha") == BASE_SHA,
+        "input_authority_base_sha_drift",
+    )
+    for key in (
+        "partition_counts",
+        "safe_rejection_membership_count",
+        "ineligible_membership_count",
+        "sealed_membership_disclosed",
+        "sealed_membership_content_inspected",
+        "semantic_processing_executed",
+    ):
+        require(leakage.get(key) == computed.get(key), f"leakage_audit_drift:{key}")
+    for key, value in leakage["overlap_counts"].items():
+        if "sealed" not in key:
+            require(value == computed["overlap_counts"][key], f"leakage_overlap_drift:{key}")
+        require(value == 0, f"leakage_nonzero:{key}")
+    gate = load_json(output_root / "receipts/contract-gate-receipt.v1.json")
+    require(gate.get("status") == "pass", "contract_gate_not_pass")
+    require(

+def validate_contract_documents(documents: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    required = set(contract_documents())
+    require(set(documents) == required, "contract_document_set_mismatch")
+    tax = documents["contracts/taxonomy.v0.1.json"]
+    families = tax.get("families", [])
+    require(
+        [item.get("name") for item in families] == list(FAMILIES),
+        "taxonomy_family_set_or_order_invalid",
+    )
+    for family in families:
+        for item in [family, *family.get("types", [])]:
+            for field in (
+                "definition",
+                "inclusion_rules",
+                "exclusion_rules",
+                "positive_examples",
+                "counterexamples",
+                "boundary_cases",
+            ):
+                value = item.get(field)
+                require(
+                    (isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip()))
+                    or (
+                        isinstance(value, list)
+                        and bool(value)
+                        and all(isinstance(entry, str) and entry.strip() for entry in value)
+                    ),
+                    f"taxonomy_required_field_invalid:{item.get('id')}:{field}",
+                )
+    machines = documents["contracts/independent-state-machines.v1.json"]["machines"]
+    require(set(machines) == {"layer_a", "layer_b", "layer_c"}, "state_machine_set_invalid")
+    state_sets = [set(machine["states"]) for machine in machines.values()]
+    require(
+        not state_sets[0] & state_sets[1]
+        and not state_sets[0] & state_sets[2]
+        and not state_sets[1] & state_sets[2],
+        "layer_state_names_not_independent",
+    )
+    require(
+        machines["layer_b"]["agreement_transition"] is None,
+        "agreement_transition_must_be_impossible",
+    )
+    require(
+        documents["contracts/math-9709-adapter.v1.json"]["layer_c_extensions"][
+            "question_level_singleton_factory"
+        ]
+        is False,
+        "question_singleton_factory_enabled",
+    )
+    for name, schema in schema_documents().items():
+        require(schema.get("$schema") == SCHEMA, f"json_schema_draft_missing:{name}")

+def validate_run_history(runs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    by_id: dict[str, str] = {}
+    parents: dict[str, str | None] = {}
+    for run in runs:
+        run_id = run["run_id"]
+        digest = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes({k: v for k, v in run.items() if k != "digest"}))
+        if run_id in by_id:
+            require(by_id[run_id] == digest, "immutable_run_mutation_rejected")
+        by_id[run_id] = digest
+        parents[run_id] = run.get("supersedes_run_id")
+        require(
+            run.get("mutation_policy") == "append_only_no_historical_overwrite",
+            "run_mutation_policy_invalid",
+        )
+    for run_id, parent in parents.items():
+        if parent is None:
+            continue
+        require(parent in parents, "supersession_predecessor_missing")
+        seen = {run_id}
+        cursor: str | None = parent
+        while cursor is not None:
+            require(cursor not in seen, "supersession_cycle")
+            seen.add(cursor)
+            cursor = parents.get(cursor)

+    hints: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

+def candidate_descriptor(
+    family: str, qid: str, row: dict[str, Any], hint: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    question = row["question"]
+    paper_id = question["paper_id"]
+    meta = paper_metadata(paper_id)
+    pages = question["complete_page_chain"]
+    regions = question["authoritative_regions"]
+    normalized_text = hint.get("normalized_plain_text", "")
+    explicit_alternative = bool(
+        re.search(
+            r"\bor otherwise\b|\bor by another method\b|\balternative method\b",
+            normalized_text,
+            re.IGNORECASE,
+        )
+    )
+    linked_method = bool(
+        re.search(
+            r"\bshow that\b|\bprove that\b|\bhence\b|\busing the substitution\b",
+            normalized_text,
+            re.IGNORECASE,
+        )
+    )
+    boundary_patterns = {
+        "Integration Techniques": (
+            r"dy/dx|\\frac\{\\mathrm\{d\}y\}|"
+            r"\barea\b|\bvolume\b|\bsin\b|\bcos\b|\btan\b"
+        ),
+        "Differential Equations": (
+            r"\btank\b|\bpopulation\b|\bproportion|\brate\b|\bmodel\b|"
+            r"\bwhen x\b|\bwhen t\b|\bwhen y\b"
+        ),
+        "Trigonometric Manipulation / Equations": (
+            r"\bshow that\b|\bprove\b|\btriangle\b|\bidentity\b|"
+            r"\bdifferentiat|\bintegrat"
+        ),
+    }
+    boundary_candidate = bool(
+        re.search(boundary_patterns.get(family, r"$a"), normalized_text, re.IGNORECASE)
+    )
+    require(bool(regions), "selected_question_authoritative_regions_missing")
+    return {
+        "question_id": qid,
+        "paper_id": paper_id,
+        "family_reservation": family,
+        "topic_hint": hint["primary_topic_path"],
+        "topic_hint_role": "selection_only_not_semantic_approval",
+        "structural_verification_state": question["verification_state"],
+        "structural_record_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(row)),
+        "source_binding_summary": [
+            {
+                "semantic_role": "structural_selection_authority",
+                "source_object_id": region["source_object_id"],
+                "source_sha256": region["source_sha256"],
+                "page_number": region["page_number"],
+                "region_id": region["region_id"],
+                "region_sha256": region["crop_sha256"],
+            }
+            for region in regions
+        ],
+        "selection_facets": {
+            **meta,
+            "era": era(meta["year"]),
+            "page_shape": "cross_page" if len(pages) > 1 else "single_page",
+            "layout_family": question["layout_family"],
+        },
+        "reservation_hints": {
+            "hint_role": "selection_only_stage_2_must_independently_confirm",
+            "explicit_alternative_wording": explicit_alternative,
+            "alternative_path_review_candidate": explicit_alternative
+            or linked_method,
+            "single_path_review_candidate": not (explicit_alternative or linked_method),
+            "taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate": boundary_candidate,
+        },
+        "semantic_processing_executed": False,
+    }

+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:

+def runtime_safety_analysis() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    source_path = Path(__file__).resolve()
+    tree = ast.parse(source_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    imports = {
+        alias.name.split(".")[0]
+        for node in ast.walk(tree)
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Import)
+        for alias in node.names
+    }
+    imports.update(
+        node.module.split(".")[0]
+        for node in ast.walk(tree)
+        if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module
+    )
+    functions = {
+        node.name for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
+    }
+    prohibited = sorted(imports & PROHIBITED_RUNTIME_IMPORTS)
+    return {
+        "runner_path": source_path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+        "runner_sha256": sha256_file(source_path),
+        "imported_modules": sorted(imports),
+        "prohibited_runtime_imports": prohibited,
+        "publication_guard_present": "validate_publication_roots" in functions,
+        "atomic_publication_present": "generate" in functions,
+        "composite_source_validator_present": "validate_layer_a_verified"
+        in functions,
+        "composite_semantic_validator_present": "validate_semantic_approval"
+        in functions,
+        "composite_procedure_validator_present": "validate_procedure_model"
+        in functions,

+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def write_json(path: Path, value: Any, mode: int = 0o644) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    data = canonical_bytes(value)
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, delete=False) as handle:
+        temporary = Path(handle.name)
+        handle.write(data)
+        handle.flush()
+        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+    os.chmod(temporary, mode)
+    os.replace(temporary, path)
+

+def require_no_symlink_components(path: Path) -> None:
+    cursor = Path(path.anchor)
+    for part in path.parts[1:]:
+        cursor = cursor / part
+        if cursor.exists():
+            require(not cursor.is_symlink(), "publication_path_symlink_rejected")
+
+
+def reject_descendant_symlinks(root: Path) -> None:
+    if not root.exists():
+        return
+    require(not root.is_symlink(), "publication_path_symlink_rejected")
+    for directory, names, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
+        parent = Path(directory)
+        for name in [*names, *files]:
+            require(
+                not (parent / name).is_symlink(),
+                "publication_descendant_symlink_rejected",
+            )
+
+
+def validate_publication_roots(
+    output_root: Path,
+    private_root: Path,
+    *,
+    allow_test_roots: bool = False,
+) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
+    output = output_root.resolve()
+    private = private_root.resolve()
+    repo = REPO.resolve()
+    require_no_symlink_components(output_root.absolute())
+    require_no_symlink_components(private_root.absolute())
+    reject_descendant_symlinks(output_root.absolute())
+    reject_descendant_symlinks(private_root.absolute())
+    if not allow_test_roots:
+        require(output == DEFAULT_OUTPUT.resolve(), "output_root_not_allowlisted")
+        require(private == DEFAULT_PRIVATE_ROOT.resolve(), "private_root_not_allowlisted")
+    else:
+        require(
+            output == DEFAULT_OUTPUT.resolve() or not output.is_relative_to(repo),
+            "test_output_root_inside_repository_rejected",
+        )
+    require(not private.is_relative_to(repo), "private_root_inside_repository_rejected")
+    require(
+        output != STRUCTURAL_ROOT.resolve()
+        and not output.is_relative_to(STRUCTURAL_ROOT.resolve()),
+        "structural_authority_write_target_rejected",
+    )
+    require(
+        output != private
+        and not output.is_relative_to(private)
+        and not private.is_relative_to(output),
+        "publication_roots_overlap",
+    )
+    prohibited_tokens = {
+        "canonical",
+        "production",
+        "mastery",
+        "formal-kg",
+        "formal_kg",
+        "downstream",
+        "supabase",
+        "storage",
+        "vector",
+        "rag",
+    }
+    require(
+        not any(token in {part.lower() for part in output.parts} for token in prohibited_tokens),
+        "prohibited_output_namespace_rejected",
+    )
+    return output, private

+def tree_snapshot(root: Path) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    require(root.is_dir(), "immutable_publication_root_not_directory")
+    reject_descendant_symlinks(root)
+    return {
+        path.relative_to(root).as_posix(): {
+            "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+            "mode": stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode),
+        }
+        for path in sorted(root.rglob("*"))
+        if path.is_file()
+    }

+def paper_metadata(paper_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:

+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:

+def runtime_safety_analysis() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    source_path = Path(__file__).resolve()
+    tree = ast.parse(source_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+    imports = {
+        alias.name.split(".")[0]
+        for node in ast.walk(tree)
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Import)
+        for alias in node.names
+    }
+    imports.update(
+        node.module.split(".")[0]
+        for node in ast.walk(tree)
+        if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module
+    )
+    functions = {
+        node.name for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
+    }
+    prohibited = sorted(imports & PROHIBITED_RUNTIME_IMPORTS)
+    return {
+        "runner_path": source_path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+        "runner_sha256": sha256_file(source_path),
+        "imported_modules": sorted(imports),
+        "prohibited_runtime_imports": prohibited,
+        "publication_guard_present": "validate_publication_roots" in functions,
+        "atomic_publication_present": "generate" in functions,
+        "composite_source_validator_present": "validate_layer_a_verified"
+        in functions,
+        "composite_semantic_validator_present": "validate_semantic_approval"
+        in functions,

+        in functions,

+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as handle:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
+            digest.update(chunk)
+    return digest.hexdigest()
+
+
+def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def write_json(path: Path, value: Any, mode: int = 0o644) -> None:
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    data = canonical_bytes(value)
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=path.parent, delete=False) as handle:
+        temporary = Path(handle.name)
+        handle.write(data)
+        handle.flush()
+        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+    os.chmod(temporary, mode)
+    os.replace(temporary, path)
+

+def require_no_symlink_components(path: Path) -> None:
+    cursor = Path(path.anchor)
+    for part in path.parts[1:]:
+        cursor = cursor / part
+        if cursor.exists():
+            require(not cursor.is_symlink(), "publication_path_symlink_rejected")
+
+
+def reject_descendant_symlinks(root: Path) -> None:
+    if not root.exists():
+        return
+    require(not root.is_symlink(), "publication_path_symlink_rejected")
+    for directory, names, files in os.walk(root, followlinks=False):
+        parent = Path(directory)
+        for name in [*names, *files]:
+            require(
+                not (parent / name).is_symlink(),
+                "publication_descendant_symlink_rejected",
+            )
+
+
+def validate_publication_roots(
+    output_root: Path,
+    private_root: Path,
+    *,
+    allow_test_roots: bool = False,
+) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
+    output = output_root.resolve()
+    private = private_root.resolve()
+    repo = REPO.resolve()
+    require_no_symlink_components(output_root.absolute())
+    require_no_symlink_components(private_root.absolute())
+    reject_descendant_symlinks(output_root.absolute())
+    reject_descendant_symlinks(private_root.absolute())
+    if not allow_test_roots:
+        require(output == DEFAULT_OUTPUT.resolve(), "output_root_not_allowlisted")
+        require(private == DEFAULT_PRIVATE_ROOT.resolve(), "private_root_not_allowlisted")
+    else:
+        require(
+            output == DEFAULT_OUTPUT.resolve() or not output.is_relative_to(repo),
+            "test_output_root_inside_repository_rejected",
+        )
+    require(not private.is_relative_to(repo), "private_root_inside_repository_rejected")
+    require(
+        output != STRUCTURAL_ROOT.resolve()
+        and not output.is_relative_to(STRUCTURAL_ROOT.resolve()),
+        "structural_authority_write_target_rejected",
+    )
+    require(
+        output != private
+        and not output.is_relative_to(private)
+        and not private.is_relative_to(output),
+        "publication_roots_overlap",
+    )
+    prohibited_tokens = {
+        "canonical",
+        "production",
+        "mastery",
+        "formal-kg",
+        "formal_kg",
+        "downstream",
+        "supabase",
+        "storage",
+        "vector",
+        "rag",
+    }
+    require(
+        not any(token in {part.lower() for part in output.parts} for token in prohibited_tokens),
+        "prohibited_output_namespace_rejected",
+    )
+    return output, private

+def tree_snapshot(root: Path) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    require(root.is_dir(), "immutable_publication_root_not_directory")
+    reject_descendant_symlinks(root)
+    return {
+        path.relative_to(root).as_posix(): {
+            "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+            "mode": stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode),
+        }
+        for path in sorted(root.rglob("*"))
+        if path.is_file()
+    }

+def validate_contract_documents(documents: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    required = set(contract_documents())
+    require(set(documents) == required, "contract_document_set_mismatch")
+    tax = documents["contracts/taxonomy.v0.1.json"]
+    families = tax.get("families", [])
+    require(
+        [item.get("name") for item in families] == list(FAMILIES),
+        "taxonomy_family_set_or_order_invalid",
+    )
+    for family in families:
+        for item in [family, *family.get("types", [])]:
+            for field in (
+                "definition",
+                "inclusion_rules",
+                "exclusion_rules",
+                "positive_examples",
+                "counterexamples",
+                "boundary_cases",
+            ):
+                value = item.get(field)
+                require(
+                    (isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip()))
+                    or (
+                        isinstance(value, list)
+                        and bool(value)
+                        and all(isinstance(entry, str) and entry.strip() for entry in value)
+                    ),
+                    f"taxonomy_required_field_invalid:{item.get('id')}:{field}",
+                )
+    machines = documents["contracts/independent-state-machines.v1.json"]["machines"]
+    require(set(machines) == {"layer_a", "layer_b", "layer_c"}, "state_machine_set_invalid")
+    state_sets = [set(machine["states"]) for machine in machines.values()]
+    require(
+        not state_sets[0] & state_sets[1]
+        and not state_sets[0] & state_sets[2]
+        and not state_sets[1] & state_sets[2],
+        "layer_state_names_not_independent",
+    )
+    require(
+        machines["layer_b"]["agreement_transition"] is None,
+        "agreement_transition_must_be_impossible",
+    )
+    require(
+        documents["contracts/math-9709-adapter.v1.json"]["layer_c_extensions"][
+            "question_level_singleton_factory"
+        ]
+        is False,
+        "question_singleton_factory_enabled",
+    )
+    for name, schema in schema_documents().items():
+        require(schema.get("$schema") == SCHEMA, f"json_schema_draft_missing:{name}")
+        require(schema.get("type") == "object", f"json_schema_root_invalid:{name}")
+        pending: list[Any] = [schema]
+        while pending:
+            value = pending.pop()
+            if isinstance(value, dict):
+                reference = value.get("$ref")
+                if isinstance(reference, str) and not reference.startswith(
+                    ("http://", "https://", "#")
+                ):
+                    target = (Path(name).parent / reference).as_posix()
+                    require(
+                        target in documents,
+                        f"json_schema_relative_ref_unresolved:{name}:{reference}",
+                    )
+                pending.extend(value.values())
+            elif isinstance(value, list):
+                pending.extend(value)

+def validate_transition(
+    machines: dict[str, Any],
+    layer: str,
+    source: str,
+    target: str,
+    evidence: Iterable[str] | dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> None:
+    require(layer in machines, "transition_layer_unknown")
+    machine = machines[layer]
+    require(source in machine["states"], "transition_source_unknown")
+    require(target in machine["states"], "transition_target_unknown")
+    require(target in machine["transitions"][source], "transition_not_allowed")
+    required = set(machine.get("approval_evidence", {}).get(target, []))
+    evidence_names = set(evidence)
+    require(required <= evidence_names, "transition_approval_evidence_missing")
+    if required:
+        require(
+            isinstance(evidence, dict),
+            "transition_evidence_not_authenticated",
+        )
+        for name in required:
+            receipt = evidence[name]
+            require(
+                isinstance(receipt, dict)
+                and receipt.get("status") == "pass"
+                and re.fullmatch(HEX64, receipt.get("artifact_sha256", ""))
+                is not None,
+                f"transition_evidence_receipt_invalid:{name}",
+            )

+def validate_against_shipped_schema(
+    schema_path: str, record: dict[str, Any]
+) -> None:
+    schemas = schema_documents()
+    require(schema_path in schemas, "shipped_schema_unknown")
+    registry = {Path(path).name: schema for path, schema in schemas.items()}
+    schema = schemas[schema_path]
+    resolver = RefResolver(base_uri="", referrer=schema, store=registry)
+    validator = Draft202012Validator(schema, resolver=resolver)
+    errors = sorted(
+        validator.iter_errors(record),
+        key=lambda error: tuple(str(part) for part in error.absolute_path),
+    )
+    if errors:
+        first = errors[0]
+        location = ".".join(str(part) for part in first.absolute_path) or "<root>"
+        raise ContractError(
+            f"shipped_schema_validation_failed:{schema_path}:{location}:{first.validator}"
+        )

+def load_pinned_root_registry(
+    filename: str,
+    expected_sha256: str,
+    authority_kind: str,
+) -> tuple[Path, Path, dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Load a checked-in trust anchor without consulting mutable path globals."""
+    module_repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+    root_path = (
+        Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "fixtures" / filename
+    ).resolve()
+    expected_path = (
+        module_repo / "scripts" / "vlm" / "fixtures" / filename
+    ).resolve()
+    require(
+        root_path == expected_path,
+        f"{authority_kind}_root_registry_path_substitution",
+    )
+    require(
+        root_path.is_file(),
+        f"{authority_kind}_root_registry_missing",
+    )
+    require(
+        sha256_file(root_path) == expected_sha256,
+        f"{authority_kind}_root_registry_pinned_hash_mismatch",
+    )
+    return module_repo, root_path, load_json(root_path)

+    )
+    matches = [
+        item
+        for item in roots.get("authorities", [])
+        if item.get("authority_id") == authority_id

+    require(len(matches) == 1, "layer_a_source_authority_root_missing_or_duplicate")

+    ledger = load_json(ledger_path)
+    require(
+        ledger.get("authority_id") == authority_id
+        and ledger.get("status") == "immutable_source_page_region_authority"
+        and ledger.get("mutation_policy") == "immutable_additive_supersession_only",
+        "layer_a_source_authority_ledger_identity_invalid",
+    )
+    registry: dict[tuple[str, int, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for entry in ledger.get("entries", []):

+            entry.get("page_number"),
+            entry.get("region_id"),

+        require(
+            isinstance(key[0], str)
+            and isinstance(key[1], int)
+            and isinstance(key[2], str)
+            and key not in registry,
+            "layer_a_source_authority_entry_invalid_or_duplicate",
+        )
+        registry[key] = entry
+    require(bool(registry), "layer_a_source_authority_ledger_empty")
+    return registry, {
+        "authority_id": authority_id,
+        "root_registry_path": root_path.relative_to(module_repo).as_posix(),
+        "root_registry_sha256": sha256_file(root_path),
+        "ledger_path": relative.as_posix(),
