+def load_rooted_approval_authority(
+    authority_id: str,
+    *,
+    layer: str,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]:
+    require(
+        isinstance(authority_id, str) and bool(authority_id),
+        f"{layer}_approval_authority_id_invalid",
+    )
+    if layer == "layer_b":
+        module_repo, root_path, roots = load_pinned_root_registry(
+            "issue_1701_layer_b_approval_authority_roots.v1.json",
+            "878b0294e4e320cf1681b38f36d7da861328005a23df614ff1be410130fd86c0",
+            "layer_b_approval_authority",
+        )
+        expected_status = "immutable_semantic_review_resolver_authority"
+    elif layer == "layer_c":
+        module_repo, root_path, roots = load_pinned_root_registry(
+            "issue_1701_layer_c_approval_authority_roots.v1.json",
+            "3f34d4c5a9eb974eb913f44b56ef50001622a90b87809627c3ef1d73251da75f",
+            "layer_c_approval_authority",
+        )
+        expected_status = "immutable_procedure_review_resolver_authority"
+    else:
+        raise ContractError("approval_authority_layer_invalid")
+    require(
+        roots.get("status") == "frozen"
+        and roots.get("mutation_policy") == "additive_authority_roots_only",
+        f"{layer}_approval_authority_roots_not_frozen",
+    )
+    matches = [
+        item
+        for item in roots.get("authorities", [])
+        if item.get("authority_id") == authority_id
+    ]
+    require(
+        len(matches) == 1,
+        f"{layer}_approval_authority_root_missing_or_duplicate",
+    )
+    root = matches[0]
+    require(
+        root.get("status") == "immutable_contract_fixture",
+        f"{layer}_approval_authority_root_not_immutable",
+    )
+    relative = Path(root["ledger_path"])
+    require(
+        not relative.is_absolute() and ".." not in relative.parts,
+        f"{layer}_approval_authority_path_invalid",
+    )
+    ledger_path = (module_repo / relative).resolve()
+    require(
+        ledger_path.is_relative_to(module_repo),
+        f"{layer}_approval_authority_path_escape",
+    )
+    require(
+        ledger_path.is_file(),
+        f"{layer}_approval_authority_ledger_missing",
+    )
+    ledger_sha256 = sha256_file(ledger_path)
+    require(
+        ledger_sha256 == root.get("ledger_sha256"),
+        f"{layer}_approval_authority_ledger_hash_mismatch",
+    )
+    ledger = load_json(ledger_path)
+    require(
+        ledger.get("authority_id") == authority_id
+        and ledger.get("status") == expected_status
+        and ledger.get("mutation_policy")
+        == "immutable_additive_supersession_only",
+        f"{layer}_approval_authority_ledger_identity_invalid",
+    )
+    review_ledger = ledger.get("review_receipts")
+    resolver_ledger = ledger.get("resolver_receipts")
+    require(
+        isinstance(review_ledger, dict)
+        and bool(review_ledger)
+        and isinstance(resolver_ledger, dict)
+        and bool(resolver_ledger),
+        f"{layer}_approval_authority_ledger_empty",
+    )
+    return review_ledger, resolver_ledger, {
+        "authority_id": authority_id,
+        "root_registry_path": root_path.relative_to(module_repo).as_posix(),
+        "root_registry_sha256": sha256_file(root_path),
+        "ledger_path": relative.as_posix(),
+        "ledger_sha256": ledger_sha256,
+        "review_receipt_count": len(review_ledger),
+        "resolver_receipt_count": len(resolver_ledger),
+        "independently_loaded": True,
+    }
+

+def rooted_approval_authority_documents() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    documents: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    module_repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+    for layer, authority_id, prefix in (
+        ("layer_b", LAYER_B_SYNTHETIC_AUTHORITY_ID, "layer-b"),
+        ("layer_c", LAYER_C_SYNTHETIC_AUTHORITY_ID, "layer-c"),
+    ):
+        _, _, receipt = load_rooted_approval_authority(

+def validate_layer_a_verified(
+    record: dict[str, Any],
+    structural_authority_records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] | None,
+    source_authority_id: str | None,
+    state_ledger: dict[str, list[str]] | None,
+) -> None:
+    validate_against_shipped_schema("contracts/layer-a.schema.v1.json", record)
+    require(record.get("state") == "source_verified", "layer_a_state_not_verified")
+    require(
+        structural_authority_records is not None,
+        "layer_a_structural_authority_missing",
+    )
+    require(source_authority_id is not None, "layer_a_source_authority_missing")
+    require(state_ledger is not None, "layer_a_state_ledger_missing")
+    source_region_registry, _ = load_rooted_layer_a_source_authority(
+        source_authority_id
+    )
+    question_id = record["question_id"]
+    authority_row = structural_authority_records.get(question_id)
+    require(authority_row is not None, "layer_a_structural_record_missing")
+    assert authority_row is not None
+    structural = record["structural_authority"]
+    require(
+        structural["record_sha256"] == sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(authority_row)),
+        "layer_a_structural_record_hash_mismatch",
+    )
+    require(
+        authority_row.get("question", {}).get("verification_state")
+        == structural["verification_state"],
+        "layer_a_structural_state_mismatch",
+    )
+    require(structural["read_only"] is True, "layer_a_structural_not_read_only")
+    require(
+        state_ledger.get(question_id) == ["source_verified"],
+        "layer_a_state_conservation_failed",
+    )
+    validate_role_typed_bindings(record["source_bindings"])
+    fact_fields_by_role = {
+        "question_text": "normalized_question_text",
+        "mathematical_expression": "mathematical_expressions",
+        "given": "givens",
+        "unknown": "unknowns",
+        "visual_reference": "visual_references",
+        "mark_point": "official_mark_points",
+        "part_ownership": "part_ownership",
+    }
+    for binding in record["source_bindings"]:
+        key = (
+            binding["source_object_id"],
+            binding["page_number"],
+            binding["region_id"],
+        )
+        expected = source_region_registry.get(key)
+        require(expected is not None, "layer_a_source_region_authority_missing")
+        assert expected is not None
+        for field in (
+            "source_sha256",
+            "region_sha256",
+            "run_id",
+            "artifact_path",
+            "artifact_sha256",
+        ):
+            observed = (
+                binding["provenance"].get(field)
+                if field in {"run_id", "artifact_path", "artifact_sha256"}
+                else binding.get(field)
+            )
+            require(
+                observed == expected.get(field),
+                f"layer_a_source_region_binding_mismatch:{field}",
+            )
+        role = binding["semantic_role"]
+        fact_field = fact_fields_by_role.get(role)
+        require(fact_field is not None, "layer_a_source_role_not_fact_bound")
+        require(
+            expected.get("semantic_role") == role
+            and expected.get("fact_field") == fact_field,
+            "layer_a_fact_region_authority_mismatch",
+        )
+        require(
+            expected.get("fact_payload_sha256")
+            == sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(record["facts"][fact_field])),
+            f"layer_a_fact_payload_hash_mismatch:{fact_field}",
+        )
+    facts = record["facts"]
+    required_roles = {"question_text"}
+    if facts["mathematical_expressions"]:
+        required_roles.add("mathematical_expression")
+    if facts["givens"]:
+        required_roles.add("given")
+    if facts["unknowns"]:
+        required_roles.add("unknown")
+    if facts["visual_references"]:
+        required_roles.add("visual_reference")
+    if facts["official_mark_points"]:
+        required_roles.add("mark_point")
+    if facts["part_ownership"]:
+        required_roles.add("part_ownership")
+    actual_roles = {binding["semantic_role"] for binding in record["source_bindings"]}
+    require(
+        required_roles <= actual_roles,
+        "layer_a_fact_role_evidence_incomplete",
+    )

+def taxonomy_indexes(
+    taxonomy_document: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, set[str]], dict[str, str]]:
+    value = taxonomy_document or taxonomy()
+    family_types: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
+    type_family: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for family in value.get("families", []):
+        family_id = family.get("id")
+        require(isinstance(family_id, str), "taxonomy_family_id_invalid")
+        type_ids = {item.get("id") for item in family.get("types", [])}
+        require(
+            all(isinstance(item, str) for item in type_ids),
+            "taxonomy_type_id_invalid",
+        )
+        family_types[family_id] = type_ids
+        for type_id in type_ids:
+            assert isinstance(type_id, str)
+            require(type_id not in type_family, "taxonomy_type_id_duplicate")
+            type_family[type_id] = family_id
+    return family_types, type_family
+
+
+def receipt_payload_sha256(receipt: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    payload = {key: value for key, value in receipt.items() if key != "artifact_sha256"}
+    return sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(payload))
+
+
+def validate_authenticated_receipt(
+    receipt: dict[str, Any] | None, receipt_kind: str
+) -> None:
+    require(isinstance(receipt, dict), f"{receipt_kind}_receipt_missing")
+    assert receipt is not None
+    require(receipt.get("status") == "pass", f"{receipt_kind}_receipt_not_pass")
+    require(
+        receipt.get("artifact_sha256") == receipt_payload_sha256(receipt),
+        f"{receipt_kind}_receipt_hash_mismatch",
+    )
+

+def validate_semantic_approval(
+    record: dict[str, Any],
+    taxonomy_document: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+    *,
+    layer_a_authority: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+    semantic_authority_id: str | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    validate_against_shipped_schema("contracts/layer-b.schema.v1.json", record)
+    require(
+        record.get("state") == "approved_semantic",
+        "authoritative_semantic_state_not_approved",
+    )
+    evidence = record.get("review_evidence", {})
+    require(bool(evidence.get("independent_review_id")), "approved_semantic_review_missing")
+    require(bool(evidence.get("resolver_decision_id")), "approved_semantic_resolver_missing")
+    actors = [
+        evidence.get("maker_actor_id"),
+        evidence.get("checker_actor_id"),
+        evidence.get("resolver_actor_id"),
+    ]
+    require(all(isinstance(actor, str) and actor for actor in actors), "semantic_actor_custody_missing")
+    require(len(set(actors)) == 3, "semantic_actor_custody_not_distinct")
+    require(bool(record.get("evidence_rationale")), "approved_semantic_rationale_missing")
+    validate_role_typed_bindings(record["evidence_rationale"])
+    require(
+        all(
+            binding.get("semantic_role") == "semantic_rationale"
+            for binding in record["evidence_rationale"]
+        ),
+        "approved_semantic_rationale_role_invalid",
+    )
+    require(
+        record.get("taxonomy_version") == "9709-semantic-taxonomy-v0.1",
+        "approved_semantic_taxonomy_binding_invalid",
+    )
+    classification = record.get("classification", {})
+    require(
+        classification.get("uncertainty") in {"low", "medium"},
+        "approved_semantic_uncertainty_unresolved",
+    )
+    contradiction = classification.get("contradiction_posture", {})
+    require(
+        contradiction.get("status") == "resolved",
+        "approved_semantic_contradiction_unresolved",
+    )
+    contradiction_ids = contradiction.get("contradiction_ids", [])
+    resolution_refs = contradiction.get("resolution_refs", [])
+    require(
+        not contradiction_ids or bool(resolution_refs),
+        "approved_semantic_contradiction_resolution_missing",
+    )
+    family_types, type_family = taxonomy_indexes(taxonomy_document)
+    family_ref = classification.get("primary_family_ref")
+    type_ref = classification.get("primary_type_ref")
+    require(family_ref in family_types, "approved_semantic_family_ref_unknown")
+    require(
+        type_ref in family_types[family_ref],
+        "approved_semantic_type_family_mismatch",
+    )
+    multi_labels = classification.get("multi_label_refs", [])
+    require(
+        isinstance(multi_labels, list)
+        and len(multi_labels) == len(set(multi_labels))
+        and all(label in type_family for label in multi_labels),
+        "approved_semantic_multi_label_ref_unknown",
+    )
+    require(
+        type_ref not in multi_labels,
+        "approved_semantic_primary_repeated_as_secondary",
+    )
+    multi_label_evidence = classification.get("multi_label_evidence", [])
+    evidence_refs = [
+        item.get("type_ref")
+        for item in multi_label_evidence
+        if isinstance(item, dict)
+    ]
+    require(
+        len(evidence_refs) == len(multi_label_evidence)
+        and len(evidence_refs) == len(set(evidence_refs))
+        and set(evidence_refs) == set(multi_labels),
+        "approved_semantic_multi_label_evidence_set_mismatch",
+    )
+    for item in multi_label_evidence:
+        bindings = item.get("evidence_bindings", [])
+        validate_role_typed_bindings(bindings)
+        require(
+            all(
+                binding.get("semantic_role") == "semantic_rationale"
+                for binding in bindings
+            ),
+            "approved_semantic_multi_label_evidence_role_invalid",
+        )
+    require(layer_a_authority is not None, "approved_semantic_layer_a_authority_missing")
+    assert layer_a_authority is not None
+    layer_a_record = layer_a_authority.get("record")
+    require(isinstance(layer_a_record, dict), "approved_semantic_layer_a_record_missing")
+    assert isinstance(layer_a_record, dict)
+    validate_layer_a_verified(
+        layer_a_record,
+        layer_a_authority.get("structural_authority_records"),
+        layer_a_authority.get("source_authority_id"),
+        layer_a_authority.get("state_ledger"),
+    )
+    require(
+        layer_a_record.get("record_id") == record.get("layer_a_record_ref")
+        and layer_a_record.get("question_id") == record.get("question_id")
+        and layer_a_authority.get("artifact_sha256")
+        == sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(layer_a_record)),
+        "approved_semantic_layer_a_binding_mismatch",
+    )
+    require(
+        semantic_authority_id is not None,
+        "approved_semantic_authority_missing",
+    )
+    review_ledger, resolver_ledger, _ = load_rooted_approval_authority(
+        semantic_authority_id,
+        layer="layer_b",
+    )
+    review = review_ledger.get(evidence["independent_review_id"])
+    decision = resolver_ledger.get(evidence["resolver_decision_id"])
+    validate_authenticated_receipt(review, "approved_semantic_review")
+    validate_authenticated_receipt(decision, "approved_semantic_resolver")
+    assert review is not None and decision is not None
+    semantic_sha256 = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(record))
+    require(
+        review.get("independent_review_id") == evidence["independent_review_id"]
+        and review.get("record_id") == record["record_id"]
+        and review.get("question_id") == record["question_id"]
+        and review.get("layer_a_record_ref") == record["layer_a_record_ref"]
+        and review.get("semantic_record_sha256") == semantic_sha256
+        and review.get("maker_actor_id") == evidence["maker_actor_id"]
+        and review.get("checker_actor_id") == evidence["checker_actor_id"]
+        and review.get("reviewer_actor_id") == evidence["checker_actor_id"]
+        and review.get("reviewed_state") == "independently_reviewed",
+        "approved_semantic_review_authority_mismatch",
+    )
+    require(
+        decision.get("resolver_decision_id") == evidence["resolver_decision_id"]
+        and decision.get("independent_review_id") == evidence["independent_review_id"]
+        and decision.get("record_id") == record["record_id"]
+        and decision.get("question_id") == record["question_id"]
+        and decision.get("layer_a_record_ref") == record["layer_a_record_ref"]
+        and decision.get("semantic_record_sha256") == semantic_sha256
+        and decision.get("resolver_actor_id") == evidence["resolver_actor_id"]
+        and decision.get("decided_state") == "approved_semantic",
+        "approved_semantic_resolver_authority_mismatch",
+    )

+def procedure_semantic_authority_sha256(
+    exemplars: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    approved_semantic_records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> str:
+    bindings = []
+    for exemplar in sorted(
+        exemplars,
+        key=lambda item: item["approved_semantic_record_ref"],
+    ):
+        authority = approved_semantic_records[
+            exemplar["approved_semantic_record_ref"]
+        ]
+        semantic = authority["record"]
+        semantic_review = semantic["review_evidence"]
+        semantic_review_ledger, semantic_resolver_ledger, _ = (
+            load_rooted_approval_authority(
+                authority["semantic_authority_id"],
+                layer="layer_b",
+            )
+        )
+        bindings.append(
+            {
+                "approved_semantic_record_ref": exemplar[
+                    "approved_semantic_record_ref"
+                ],
+                "approved_semantic_sha256": exemplar[
+                    "approved_semantic_sha256"
+                ],
+                "semantic_review_receipt_sha256": semantic_review_ledger[
+                    semantic_review["independent_review_id"]
+                ][
+                    "artifact_sha256"
+                ],
+                "semantic_resolver_receipt_sha256": semantic_resolver_ledger[
+                    semantic_review["resolver_decision_id"]
+                ][
+                    "artifact_sha256"
+                ],
+                "layer_a_artifact_sha256": authority["layer_a_authority"][
+                    "artifact_sha256"
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+    return sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(bindings))

+def validate_procedure_model(

+    require(
+        "generated_for_question_id" not in record,
+        "question_singleton_procedure_factory_rejected",
+    )
+    require(
+        record.get("state") == "approved_procedure",
+        "authoritative_procedure_state_not_approved",
+    )
+    exemplars = record.get("applicability", {}).get("question_exemplar_refs", [])
+    exemplar_ids = [
+        item.get("question_id") for item in exemplars if isinstance(item, dict)
+    ]
+    require(
+        len(exemplars) >= 2 and len(set(exemplar_ids)) >= 2,
+        "approved_procedure_requires_two_independent_exemplars",
+    )
+    review = record.get("review_evidence", {})
+    require(bool(review.get("procedure_review_id")), "approved_procedure_review_missing")
+    require(bool(review.get("resolver_decision_id")), "approved_procedure_resolver_missing")
+    actors = [
+        review.get("procedure_maker_actor_id"),
+        review.get("procedure_reviewer_actor_id"),
+        review.get("resolver_actor_id"),
+    ]
+    require(all(isinstance(actor, str) and actor for actor in actors), "procedure_actor_custody_missing")
+    require(len(set(actors)) == 3, "procedure_actor_custody_not_distinct")
+    applicability = record.get("applicability", {})
+    _, type_family = taxonomy_indexes(taxonomy_document)
+    type_refs = applicability.get("question_type_refs", [])
+    require(
+        isinstance(type_refs, list)
+        and bool(type_refs)
+        and len(type_refs) == len(set(type_refs))
+        and all(item in type_family for item in type_refs),
+        "approved_procedure_type_ref_unknown",
+    )
+    require(
+        approved_semantic_records is not None,
+        "approved_procedure_exemplar_authority_missing",
+    )
+    assert approved_semantic_records is not None
+    for exemplar in exemplars:
+        require(isinstance(exemplar, dict), "approved_procedure_exemplar_shape_invalid")
+        semantic_ref = exemplar.get("approved_semantic_record_ref")
+        semantic_authority = approved_semantic_records.get(semantic_ref)
+        require(
+            isinstance(semantic_authority, dict),
+            "approved_procedure_exemplar_semantic_missing",
+        )
+        assert isinstance(semantic_authority, dict)
+        semantic = semantic_authority.get("record")
+        require(
+            isinstance(semantic, dict),
+            "approved_procedure_exemplar_semantic_record_missing",
+        )
+        assert isinstance(semantic, dict)
+        validate_semantic_approval(

+            semantic_authority_id=semantic_authority.get(
+                "semantic_authority_id"
+            ),
+        )
+        require(
+            semantic.get("question_id") == exemplar.get("question_id"),
+            "approved_procedure_exemplar_question_mismatch",
+        )
+        require(
+            sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(semantic))
+            == exemplar.get("approved_semantic_sha256"),
+            "approved_procedure_exemplar_hash_mismatch",
+        )
+        primary_type = semantic.get("classification", {}).get("primary_type_ref")
+        require(
+            primary_type == exemplar.get("primary_type_ref")
+            and primary_type in type_refs,
+            "approved_procedure_exemplar_type_mismatch",
+        )
+    semantic_authority_sha256 = procedure_semantic_authority_sha256(
+        exemplars,
+        approved_semantic_records,
+    )
+    require(
+        procedure_authority_id is not None,
+        "approved_procedure_authority_missing",
+    )
+    procedure_review_ledger, procedure_resolver_ledger, _ = (
+        load_rooted_approval_authority(
+            procedure_authority_id,
+            layer="layer_c",

+    review_receipt = procedure_review_ledger.get(review["procedure_review_id"])
+    resolver_receipt = procedure_resolver_ledger.get(
+        review["resolver_decision_id"]
+    )
+    validate_authenticated_receipt(
+        review_receipt, "approved_procedure_review"
+    )
+    validate_authenticated_receipt(
+        resolver_receipt, "approved_procedure_resolver"
+    )
+    assert review_receipt is not None and resolver_receipt is not None
+    procedure_sha256 = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(record))
+    require(
+        review_receipt.get("procedure_review_id")
+        == review["procedure_review_id"]
+        and review_receipt.get("procedure_model_id")
+        == record["procedure_model_id"]
+        and review_receipt.get("revision_id") == record["revision_id"]
+        and review_receipt.get("run_id") == record["run_id"]
+        and review_receipt.get("procedure_record_sha256") == procedure_sha256

+        == review["procedure_reviewer_actor_id"]
+        and review_receipt.get("reviewed_state") == "procedure_reviewed"

+        resolver_receipt.get("resolver_decision_id")

+        and resolver_receipt.get("procedure_review_id")
+        == review["procedure_review_id"]
+        and resolver_receipt.get("procedure_model_id")

+        and resolver_receipt.get("run_id") == record["run_id"]
+        and resolver_receipt.get("procedure_record_sha256")
+        == procedure_sha256
+        and resolver_receipt.get("resolver_actor_id")
+        == review["resolver_actor_id"]
+        and resolver_receipt.get("decided_state") == "approved_procedure"
+        and resolver_receipt.get("approved_semantic_authority_sha256")
+        == semantic_authority_sha256,

+    steps = record.get("procedure_steps", [])

+    require(

+def validate_role_typed_bindings(bindings: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    require(bool(bindings), "source_binding_missing")
+    for binding in bindings:
+        for field in (
+            "binding_id",
+            "semantic_role",
+            "source_object_id",
+            "source_sha256",
+            "page_number",
+            "region_id",
+            "region_sha256",
+            "rationale",
+            "provenance",
+        ):
+            require(binding.get(field) not in (None, "", []), f"source_binding_field_missing:{field}")
+        require(
+            re.fullmatch(HEX64, binding["source_sha256"]) is not None,
+            "source_binding_source_hash_invalid",
+        )
+        require(
+            re.fullmatch(HEX64, binding["region_sha256"]) is not None,
+            "source_binding_region_hash_invalid",
+        )
+        provenance = binding.get("provenance")
+        require(
+            isinstance(provenance, dict),
+            "source_binding_provenance_invalid",
+        )
+        for field in ("run_id", "artifact_path", "artifact_sha256"):
+            require(
+                provenance.get(field) not in (None, "", []),
+                f"source_binding_provenance_field_missing:{field}",
+            )
+        artifact_path = Path(provenance["artifact_path"])
+        require(
+            not artifact_path.is_absolute() and ".." not in artifact_path.parts,
+            "source_binding_provenance_path_invalid",
+        )
+        require(
+            re.fullmatch(HEX64, provenance["artifact_sha256"]) is not None,
+            "source_binding_provenance_hash_invalid",
+        )

+def validate_run_history(runs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    by_id: dict[str, str] = {}
+    parents: dict[str, str | None] = {}
+    identity_hashes: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}
+    for run in runs:
+        run_id = run["run_id"]
+        digest = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes({k: v for k, v in run.items() if k != "digest"}))
+        if run_id in by_id:
+            require(by_id[run_id] == digest, "immutable_run_mutation_rejected")
+        by_id[run_id] = digest
+        parents[run_id] = run.get("supersedes_run_id")
+        require(
+            run.get("mutation_policy") == "append_only_no_historical_overwrite",
+            "run_mutation_policy_invalid",
+        )
+        records = run.get("records")
+        require(isinstance(records, list), "run_records_invalid")
+        for record in records:
+            require(isinstance(record, dict), "run_record_invalid")
+            record_id = record.get("record_id")
+            content_hash = record.get("content_sha256")
+            require(
+                isinstance(record_id, str) and bool(record_id),
+                "run_record_id_missing",
+            )
+            require(
+                isinstance(content_hash, str)
+                and re.fullmatch(HEX64, content_hash) is not None,
+                "run_record_content_hash_invalid",
+            )
+            identities = [("record_id", record_id)]
+            revision_id = record.get("revision_id")
+            if revision_id is not None:
+                require(
+                    isinstance(revision_id, str) and bool(revision_id),
+                    "run_revision_id_invalid",
+                )
+                identities.append(("revision_id", revision_id))
+            for identity in identities:
+                if identity in identity_hashes:
+                    require(
+                        identity_hashes[identity] == content_hash,
+                        f"immutable_record_or_revision_mutation_rejected:{identity[0]}",
+                    )
+                identity_hashes[identity] = content_hash
+    for run_id, parent in parents.items():
+        if parent is None:
+            continue
+        require(parent in parents, "supersession_predecessor_missing")
+        seen = {run_id}
+        cursor: str | None = parent
+        while cursor is not None:
+            require(cursor not in seen, "supersession_cycle")
+            seen.add(cursor)
+            cursor = parents.get(cursor)
+

+        "preview_stale_reference_rejected",

+    require(
+        readback.get("render_sha256") == expected_render,

+def build_candidate_rows() -> tuple[
+    dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    set[str],
+    dict[str, Any],
+]:
+    structural = load_json(STRUCTURAL_CORPUS)
+    safe = load_json(STRUCTURAL_SAFE_REJECTIONS)
+    paper_ledger = load_json(STRUCTURAL_PAPER_LEDGER)
+    text = load_json(TEXT_HINTS)
+    require(structural.get("verified_count") == 3497, "structural_verified_count_drift")
+    require(len(structural.get("rows", [])) == 3497, "structural_row_count_drift")
+    require(safe.get("count") == 36, "safe_rejection_count_drift")
+    require(len(safe.get("rows", [])) == 36, "safe_rejection_rows_drift")
+    require(
+        structural.get("allowed_states") == ["resolver_verified", "verified_agreement"],
+        "structural_allowed_states_drift",
+    )
+    eligible: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for row in structural["rows"]:
+        qid = row["question_id"]
+        require(qid not in eligible, "duplicate_structural_question")
+        require(
+            row["question"]["verification_state"] in structural["allowed_states"],
+            "ineligible_structural_state",
+        )
+        eligible[qid] = row
+    rejected = {row["question_id"] for row in safe["rows"]}
+    require(not rejected & set(eligible), "safe_rejection_readmitted")
+    papers = {row["paper_id"]: row for row in paper_ledger["rows"]}
+    require(len(papers) == 432, "paper_ledger_count_drift")
+    hints: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for item in text["items"]:
+        qid = qid_from_text_item(item)
+        if qid not in eligible:
+            continue
+        paper_id = eligible[qid]["question"]["paper_id"]
+        require(paper_id in papers, "eligible_paper_missing")

+                    "data/past-papers/", "data/past-papers/"
+                ),

+            "text_hint_paper_binding_drift",
+        )

+        ),
+        "Trigonometric Manipulation / Equations": (
+            r"\bshow that\b|\bprove\b|\btriangle\b|\bidentity\b|"
+            r"\bdifferentiat|\bintegrat"
+        ),
+    }
+    boundary_candidate = bool(
+        re.search(boundary_patterns.get(family, r"$a"), normalized_text, re.IGNORECASE)
+    )
+    require(bool(regions), "selected_question_authoritative_regions_missing")
+    return {
+        "question_id": qid,
+        "paper_id": paper_id,
+        "family_reservation": family,
+        "topic_hint": hint["primary_topic_path"],
+        "topic_hint_role": "selection_only_not_semantic_approval",
+        "structural_verification_state": question["verification_state"],
+        "structural_record_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(row)),
+        "source_binding_summary": [
+            {
+                "semantic_role": "structural_selection_authority",
+                "source_object_id": region["source_object_id"],
+                "source_sha256": region["source_sha256"],
+                "page_number": region["page_number"],
+                "region_id": region["region_id"],
+                "region_sha256": region["crop_sha256"],
+            }
+            for region in regions
+        ],
+        "selection_facets": {
+            **meta,
+            "era": era(meta["year"]),
+            "page_shape": "cross_page" if len(pages) > 1 else "single_page",
+            "layout_family": question["layout_family"],
+        },
+        "reservation_hints": {
+            "hint_role": "selection_only_stage_2_must_independently_confirm",
+            "explicit_alternative_wording": explicit_alternative,
+            "alternative_path_review_candidate": explicit_alternative
+            or linked_method,
+            "single_path_review_candidate": not (explicit_alternative or linked_method),
+            "taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate": boundary_candidate,
+        },
+        "semantic_processing_executed": False,
+    }

+def core_candidates(
+    eligible: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], hints: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]
+) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    result: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {family: [] for family in FAMILIES}
+    for qid, hint in hints.items():
+        for family, topic_paths in FAMILY_TOPIC_HINTS.items():
+            if hint["primary_topic_path"] in topic_paths:
+                result[family].append(candidate_descriptor(family, qid, eligible[qid], hint))
+    return result

+def ranked(
+    candidates: Iterable[dict[str, Any]], seed: str, label: str
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    return sorted(
+        candidates,
+        key=lambda row: (
+            stable_score(seed, label, row["question_id"]),
+            row["question_id"],
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def select_family(
+    candidates: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    count: int,
+    seed: str,
+    label: str,
+    used_papers: set[str],
+    coverage: bool,
+    preferred_papers: set[str] | None = None,
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    available = [
+        row
+        for row in ranked(candidates, seed, label)
+        if row["paper_id"] not in used_papers
+    ]
+    preferred_papers = preferred_papers or set()
+    available.sort(
+        key=lambda row: (
+            0 if row["paper_id"] in preferred_papers else 1,
+            stable_score(seed, label, row["question_id"]),
+            row["question_id"],
+        )
+    )
+    selected: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def take(predicate: Any, code: str) -> None:
+        for row in available:
+            if row in selected or row["paper_id"] in used_papers:
+                continue
+            if predicate(row):
+                selected.append(row)
+                used_papers.add(row["paper_id"])
+                return
+        raise ContractError(f"insufficient_coverage:{label}:{code}")
+
+    if coverage:
+        for session in ("m", "s", "w"):
+            take(
+                lambda row, value=session: row["selection_facets"]["session"] == value,
+                f"session_{session}",
+            )
+        for era_name in ("2016_2018", "2019_2022", "2023_2025"):
+            take(
+                lambda row, value=era_name: row["selection_facets"]["era"] == value,
+                f"era_{era_name}",
+            )
+        for shape in ("single_page", "cross_page"):
+            take(
+                lambda row, value=shape: row["selection_facets"]["page_shape"] == value,
+                f"page_shape_{shape}",
+            )
+        for index in range(2):
+            take(
+                lambda row: row["reservation_hints"][
+                    "alternative_path_review_candidate"
+                ],
+                f"alternative_path_review_candidate_{index + 1}",
+            )
+        for index in range(2):
+            take(
+                lambda row: row["reservation_hints"]["single_path_review_candidate"],
+                f"single_path_review_candidate_{index + 1}",
+            )
+        for index in range(2):
+            take(
+                lambda row: row["reservation_hints"][
+                    "taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate"
+                ],
+                f"taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate_{index + 1}",
+            )
+        if label != "Differential Equations":
+            for paper in (1, 3):
+                take(
+                    lambda row, value=paper: row["selection_facets"]["paper"] == value,
+                    f"paper_{paper}",
+                )
+    for row in available:
+        if len(selected) == count:
+            break
+        if row in selected or row["paper_id"] in used_papers:
+            continue
+        selected.append(row)
+        used_papers.add(row["paper_id"])
+    require(len(selected) == count, f"insufficient_family_count:{label}")
+    return sorted(selected, key=lambda row: row["question_id"])
+
+
+def build_walking(
+    candidates: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]], used_papers: set[str]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    members: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    partition_papers: set[str] = set()
+    for family in SELECTION_ORDER:
+        family_papers = set(used_papers)
+        chosen = select_family(
+            candidates[family],
+            16,
+            "issue-1701-selection-v1",
+            family,
+            family_papers,
+            coverage=True,
+            preferred_papers=partition_papers,
+        )
+        members.extend(chosen)
+        partition_papers.update(row["paper_id"] for row in chosen)
+    used_papers.update(row["paper_id"] for row in members)
+    coverage = coverage_summary(members)
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "9709_semantic_walking_selection.v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "partition": "walking",
+        "status": "membership_frozen_execution_denied",
+        "semantic_processing_executed": False,
+        "member_count": len(members),
+        "family_counts": dict(sorted(Counter(row["family_reservation"] for row in members).items())),
+        "members": sorted(members, key=lambda row: (row["family_reservation"], row["question_id"])),
+        "coverage": coverage,
+        "selection_hint_non_claim": (
+            "Family reservations use pre-existing topic hints for stratification only; "
+            "Stage 2 must independently review every semantic classification."
+        ),
+    }

+def stress_candidates(

+) -> dict[int, list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+    for qid, hint in hints.items():

+def ensure_private_key(private_root: Path) -> tuple[Path, bytes]:
+    private_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    os.chmod(private_root, 0o700)
+    key_path = private_root / "sealed-holdout-hmac.key"
+    if key_path.exists():
+        mode = stat.S_IMODE(key_path.stat().st_mode)
+        require(mode == 0o600, "sealed_key_permissions_invalid")
+        key = key_path.read_bytes()
+        require(len(key) == 32, "sealed_key_length_invalid")
+        return key_path, key
+    key = secrets.token_bytes(32)
+    descriptor = os.open(key_path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
+    with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as handle:
+        handle.write(key)
+        handle.flush()
+        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+    return key_path, key
+

+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "partition": "sealed_holdout",

+                "family_reservation": row["family_reservation"],
+                "structural_record_sha256": row["structural_record_sha256"],

+def build_sealed(

+    used_papers: set[str],
+    private_root: Path,
+    public_partitions: dict[str, tuple[set[str], set[str]]] | None = None,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    key_path, key = ensure_private_key(private_root)
+    private_ranking_seed = hmac.new(
+        key,
+        b"issue-1701-sealed-membership-ranking-v2",
+        hashlib.sha256,
+    ).hexdigest()
+    members: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    partition_papers: set[str] = set()
+    for family in SELECTION_ORDER:
+        family_papers = set(used_papers)
+        chosen = select_family(
+            candidates[family],
+            16,
+            private_ranking_seed,
+            f"sealed:{family}",
+            family_papers,
+            coverage=False,
+            preferred_papers=partition_papers,
+        )
+        members.extend(chosen)
+        partition_papers.update(row["paper_id"] for row in chosen)
+    used_papers.update(row["paper_id"] for row in members)
+    private_payload = private_membership_payload(members)
+    private_path = private_root / "sealed-holdout-membership.v1.json"
+    write_json(private_path, private_payload, 0o600)
+    private_bytes = canonical_bytes(private_payload)
+    membership_hmac = hmac.new(key, private_bytes, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
+    membership_sha256 = sha256_bytes(private_bytes)
+    question_tokens = sorted(
+        hmac.new(key, row["question_id"].encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
+        for row in members
+    )
+    paper_tokens = sorted(
+        hmac.new(key, row["paper_id"].encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
+        for row in members
+    )
+    family_counts = dict(
+        sorted(Counter(row["family_reservation"] for row in members).items())
+    )
+    question_root = merkle_root(question_tokens)
+    paper_root = merkle_root(paper_tokens)
+    key_id = sha256_bytes(key)
+    custody_envelope = {
+        "membership_hmac_sha256": membership_hmac,
+        "membership_sha256": membership_sha256,
+        "membership_byte_length": len(private_bytes),
+        "member_count": len(members),
+        "family_counts": family_counts,
+        "question_token_merkle_root": question_root,
+        "paper_token_merkle_root": paper_root,
+        "key_id_sha256": key_id,
+    }
+    custody_envelope_hmac = hmac.new(
+        key, canonical_bytes(custody_envelope), hashlib.sha256
+    ).hexdigest()
+    commitment = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_semantic_sealed_holdout_commitment.v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "partition": "sealed_holdout",
+        "status": "membership_created_hashed_and_sealed_execution_denied",
+        "member_count": len(members),
+        "family_counts": family_counts,
+        "membership_disclosed": False,
+        "membership_inspected": False,
+        "semantic_processing_executed": False,
+        "commitment": {
+            "algorithm": "HMAC-SHA-256",
+            "membership_ranking": "HMAC-SHA-256-with-private-custody-key",
+            "membership_hmac_sha256": membership_hmac,
+            "membership_sha256": membership_sha256,
+            "membership_byte_length": len(private_bytes),
+            "question_token_merkle_root": question_root,
+            "paper_token_merkle_root": paper_root,
+            "key_id_sha256": key_id,
+            "custody_envelope_hmac_sha256": custody_envelope_hmac,
+            "key_committed_to_git": False,
+            "plaintext_committed_to_git": False,
+        },
+        "authorization": {
+            "required": "explicit_owner_authorization_after_calibration_and_final_freeze",
+            "reveal_allowed": False,
+            "inspect_allowed": False,
+            "process_allowed": False,
+            "tune_allowed": False,
+            "execute_allowed": False,
+        },
+    }
+    creation_overlap_counts = {
+        "walking_sealed_question_overlap": 0,
+        "walking_sealed_paper_overlap": 0,
+        "calibration_sealed_question_overlap": 0,
+        "calibration_sealed_paper_overlap": 0,
+    }
+    if public_partitions is not None:
+        sealed_question_ids = {row["question_id"] for row in members}
+        sealed_paper_ids = {row["paper_id"] for row in members}
+        for partition in ("walking", "calibration"):
+            public_question_ids, public_paper_ids = public_partitions[partition]
+            creation_overlap_counts[
+                f"{partition}_sealed_question_overlap"
+            ] = len(public_question_ids & sealed_question_ids)
+            creation_overlap_counts[
+                f"{partition}_sealed_paper_overlap"
+            ] = len(public_paper_ids & sealed_paper_ids)
+    require(
+        all(value == 0 for value in creation_overlap_counts.values()),
+        "sealed_creation_partition_group_leakage",
+    )
+    creation_proof = {
+        "overlap_counts": creation_overlap_counts,
+        "safe_rejection_membership_count": 0,
+        "ineligible_membership_count": 0,
+        "proof_scope": "creation_time_aggregate_only_no_member_content",
+    }
+    commitment["creation_proof"] = creation_proof
+    custody_envelope["creation_proof"] = creation_proof
+    commitment["commitment"]["custody_envelope_hmac_sha256"] = hmac.new(
+        key, canonical_bytes(custody_envelope), hashlib.sha256
+    ).hexdigest()
+    private_receipt = {
+        "private_path": str(private_path),
+        "key_path": str(key_path),
+        "member_count": len(members),
+        "family_counts": family_counts,
+        "membership_hmac_sha256": membership_hmac,
+        "membership_sha256": membership_sha256,
+        "membership_byte_length": len(private_bytes),
+        "creation_overlap_counts": creation_overlap_counts,
+        "safe_rejection_membership_count": 0,
+        "ineligible_membership_count": 0,
+        "membership_content_retained": False,
+    }
+    return commitment, private_receipt

+def merkle_root(tokens: list[str]) -> str:
+    require(bool(tokens), "merkle_tree_empty")
+    level = [bytes.fromhex(token) for token in tokens]
+    while len(level) > 1:
+        if len(level) % 2:
+            level.append(level[-1])
+        level = [
+            hashlib.sha256(level[index] + level[index + 1]).digest()
+            for index in range(0, len(level), 2)
+        ]
+    return level[0].hex()
+

+        facets = [row["selection_facets"] for row in rows]
+        by_family[family] = {

+                bool(row["reservation_hints"]["alternative_path_review_candidate"])
+                for row in rows

+            "single_path_review_candidate_count": sum(
+                bool(row["reservation_hints"]["single_path_review_candidate"])
+                for row in rows

+                {f"P{row['selection_facets']['paper']}" for row in members}
+            ),
+            "sessions": sorted(
+                {row["selection_facets"]["session"] for row in members}

+            "eras": sorted({row["selection_facets"]["era"] for row in members}),

+def validate_selections(
+    walking: dict[str, Any],
+    calibration: dict[str, Any],
+    sealed: dict[str, Any],
+    private_receipt: dict[str, Any] | None,
+    eligible: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    hints: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+    rejected: set[str],
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    def validate_public_members(document: dict[str, Any], partition: str) -> None:
+        members = document.get("members", [])
+        require(
+            members
+            == sorted(
+                members,
+                key=lambda row: (
+                    row["family_reservation"],
+                    row["question_id"],
+                ),
+            ),
+            f"{partition}_member_order_drift",
+        )
+        for member in members:
+            qid = member["question_id"]
+            require(qid not in rejected, "safe_rejection_in_public_selection")
+            require(qid in eligible, f"{partition}_member_ineligible")
+            require(qid in hints, f"{partition}_topic_hint_missing")
+            family = member["family_reservation"]
+            if family in FAMILIES:
+                require(
+                    hints[qid]["primary_topic_path"] in FAMILY_TOPIC_HINTS[family],
+                    f"{partition}_family_topic_hint_mismatch",
+                )
+                expected = candidate_descriptor(family, qid, eligible[qid], hints[qid])
+            else:
+                match = re.fullmatch(r"adapter_stress_p([456])", family)
+                require(match is not None, f"{partition}_stratum_invalid")
+                require(
+                    int(hints[qid]["paper"]) == int(match.group(1)),
+                    f"{partition}_adapter_paper_mismatch",
+                )
+                expected = candidate_descriptor(family, qid, eligible[qid], hints[qid])
+                expected["allowed_terminal_posture"] = [
+                    "taxonomy_review_required",
+                    "adapter_extension_required",
+                    "out_of_current_scope",
+                ]

+    return sha256_bytes("\x1f".join((seed, *parts)).encode("utf-8"))
+
+
+def qid_from_text_item(item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    parts = item["storage_key"].split("/")
+    require(
+        len(parts) == 4 and parts[0] == "9709" and parts[2] == "questions",
+        "text_hint_storage_key_invalid",
+    )
+    return f"qrow_{parts[0]}_{parts[1]}_{Path(parts[3]).stem}"
+

+def paper_metadata(paper_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"9709_([msw])([0-9]{2})_qp_([1-6])([1-5])", paper_id)
+    require(match is not None, "paper_id_invalid")
+    assert match is not None
+    return {
+        "session": match.group(1),
+        "year": 2000 + int(match.group(2)),
+        "paper": int(match.group(3)),
+        "variant": int(match.group(4)),
+    }
+
+
+def era(year: int) -> str:
+    if year <= 2018:
+        return "2016_2018"
+    if year <= 2022:
+        return "2019_2022"
+    return "2023_2025"

+def validate_contract_documents(documents: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    required = set(contract_documents())
+    require(set(documents) == required, "contract_document_set_mismatch")
+    tax = documents["contracts/taxonomy.v0.1.json"]
+    families = tax.get("families", [])
+    require(
+        [item.get("name") for item in families] == list(FAMILIES),
+        "taxonomy_family_set_or_order_invalid",
+    )
+    for family in families:
+        for item in [family, *family.get("types", [])]:
+            for field in (
+                "definition",
+                "inclusion_rules",
+                "exclusion_rules",
+                "positive_examples",
+                "counterexamples",
+                "boundary_cases",
+            ):
+                value = item.get(field)
+                require(
+                    (isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip()))
+                    or (
+                        isinstance(value, list)
+                        and bool(value)
+                        and all(isinstance(entry, str) and entry.strip() for entry in value)
+                    ),
+                    f"taxonomy_required_field_invalid:{item.get('id')}:{field}",
+                )
+    machines = documents["contracts/independent-state-machines.v1.json"]["machines"]
+    require(set(machines) == {"layer_a", "layer_b", "layer_c"}, "state_machine_set_invalid")
+    state_sets = [set(machine["states"]) for machine in machines.values()]
+    require(
+        not state_sets[0] & state_sets[1]
+        and not state_sets[0] & state_sets[2]
+        and not state_sets[1] & state_sets[2],
+        "layer_state_names_not_independent",
+    )
+    require(
+        machines["layer_b"]["agreement_transition"] is None,
+        "agreement_transition_must_be_impossible",
+    )
+    require(
+        documents["contracts/math-9709-adapter.v1.json"]["layer_c_extensions"][
+            "question_level_singleton_factory"
+        ]
+        is False,
+        "question_singleton_factory_enabled",
+    )
+    for name, schema in schema_documents().items():
+        require(schema.get("$schema") == SCHEMA, f"json_schema_draft_missing:{name}")
+        require(schema.get("type") == "object", f"json_schema_root_invalid:{name}")
+        pending: list[Any] = [schema]
+        while pending:
+            value = pending.pop()
+            if isinstance(value, dict):
+                reference = value.get("$ref")
+                if isinstance(reference, str) and not reference.startswith(
+                    ("http://", "https://", "#")
+                ):
+                    target = (Path(name).parent / reference).as_posix()
+                    require(
+                        target in documents,
+                        f"json_schema_relative_ref_unresolved:{name}:{reference}",
+                    )
+                pending.extend(value.values())
+            elif isinstance(value, list):
+                pending.extend(value)

+def validate_transition(
+    machines: dict[str, Any],
+    layer: str,
+    source: str,
+    target: str,
+    evidence: Iterable[str] | dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> None:
+    require(layer in machines, "transition_layer_unknown")
+    machine = machines[layer]
+    require(source in machine["states"], "transition_source_unknown")
+    require(target in machine["states"], "transition_target_unknown")
+    require(target in machine["transitions"][source], "transition_not_allowed")
+    required = set(machine.get("approval_evidence", {}).get(target, []))
+    evidence_names = set(evidence)
+    require(required <= evidence_names, "transition_approval_evidence_missing")
+    if required:
+        require(
+            isinstance(evidence, dict),
+            "transition_evidence_not_authenticated",
+        )
+        for name in required:
+            receipt = evidence[name]
+            require(
+                isinstance(receipt, dict)
+                and receipt.get("status") == "pass"
+                and re.fullmatch(HEX64, receipt.get("artifact_sha256", ""))
+                is not None,
+                f"transition_evidence_receipt_invalid:{name}",
+            )

+def validate_against_shipped_schema(
+    schema_path: str, record: dict[str, Any]
+) -> None:
+    schemas = schema_documents()
+    require(schema_path in schemas, "shipped_schema_unknown")
+    registry = {Path(path).name: schema for path, schema in schemas.items()}
+    schema = schemas[schema_path]
+    resolver = RefResolver(base_uri="", referrer=schema, store=registry)
+    validator = Draft202012Validator(schema, resolver=resolver)
+    errors = sorted(
+        validator.iter_errors(record),
+        key=lambda error: tuple(str(part) for part in error.absolute_path),
+    )
+    if errors:
+        first = errors[0]
+        location = ".".join(str(part) for part in first.absolute_path) or "<root>"
+        raise ContractError(
+            f"shipped_schema_validation_failed:{schema_path}:{location}:{first.validator}"
+        )

+def load_pinned_root_registry(
+    filename: str,
+    expected_sha256: str,
+    authority_kind: str,
+) -> tuple[Path, Path, dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Load a checked-in trust anchor without consulting mutable path globals."""
+    module_repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+    root_path = (
+        Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "fixtures" / filename
+    ).resolve()
+    expected_path = (
+        module_repo / "scripts" / "vlm" / "fixtures" / filename
+    ).resolve()
+    require(
+        root_path == expected_path,
+        f"{authority_kind}_root_registry_path_substitution",
+    )
+    require(
+        root_path.is_file(),
+        f"{authority_kind}_root_registry_missing",
+    )
+    require(
+        sha256_file(root_path) == expected_sha256,
+        f"{authority_kind}_root_registry_pinned_hash_mismatch",
+    )
+    return module_repo, root_path, load_json(root_path)

+    module_repo, root_path, roots = load_pinned_root_registry(

+        "fa4929bc394deaaa980954bec6361fddf27890f4b2fe18ad93afc56100da4328",
+        "layer_a_source_authority",
+    )
+    require(
+        roots.get("status") == "frozen"
+        and roots.get("mutation_policy") == "additive_authority_roots_only",
+        "layer_a_source_authority_roots_not_frozen",
+    )
+    matches = [
+        item
+        for item in roots.get("authorities", [])
+        if item.get("authority_id") == authority_id
+    ]
+    require(len(matches) == 1, "layer_a_source_authority_root_missing_or_duplicate")
+    root = matches[0]
+    require(
+        root.get("status") == "immutable_contract_fixture",

+    relative = Path(root["ledger_path"])
+    require(

+        "layer_a_source_authority_path_invalid",
+    )
+    ledger_path = (module_repo / relative).resolve()
+    require(
+        ledger_path.is_relative_to(module_repo),

+    require(ledger_path.is_file(), "layer_a_source_authority_ledger_missing")

+    source_region_registry, _ = load_rooted_layer_a_source_authority(

+    assert authority_row is not None

+        structural["record_sha256"] == sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(authority_row)),
+        "layer_a_structural_record_hash_mismatch",
+    )
+    require(
+        authority_row.get("question", {}).get("verification_state")
+        == structural["verification_state"],
+        "layer_a_structural_state_mismatch",
+    )
+    require(structural["read_only"] is True, "layer_a_structural_not_read_only")
+    require(
+        state_ledger.get(question_id) == ["source_verified"],
+        "layer_a_state_conservation_failed",
+    )
+    validate_role_typed_bindings(record["source_bindings"])
+    fact_fields_by_role = {
+        "question_text": "normalized_question_text",
+        "mathematical_expression": "mathematical_expressions",
+        "given": "givens",
+        "unknown": "unknowns",
+        "visual_reference": "visual_references",
+        "mark_point": "official_mark_points",
+        "part_ownership": "part_ownership",
+    }
+    for binding in record["source_bindings"]:
+        key = (
+            binding["source_object_id"],
+            binding["page_number"],
+            binding["region_id"],
+        )
+        expected = source_region_registry.get(key)
+        require(expected is not None, "layer_a_source_region_authority_missing")
+        assert expected is not None
+        for field in (
+            "source_sha256",
+            "region_sha256",
+            "run_id",
+            "artifact_path",
+            "artifact_sha256",
+        ):
+            observed = (
+                binding["provenance"].get(field)
+                if field in {"run_id", "artifact_path", "artifact_sha256"}
+                else binding.get(field)
+            )
+            require(
+                observed == expected.get(field),
+                f"layer_a_source_region_binding_mismatch:{field}",
+            )
+        role = binding["semantic_role"]
+        fact_field = fact_fields_by_role.get(role)
+        require(fact_field is not None, "layer_a_source_role_not_fact_bound")
+        require(
+            expected.get("semantic_role") == role
+            and expected.get("fact_field") == fact_field,
+            "layer_a_fact_region_authority_mismatch",
+        )
+        require(
+            expected.get("fact_payload_sha256")
+            == sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(record["facts"][fact_field])),
+            f"layer_a_fact_payload_hash_mismatch:{fact_field}",
+        )
+    facts = record["facts"]
+    required_roles = {"question_text"}
+    if facts["mathematical_expressions"]:
+        required_roles.add("mathematical_expression")
+    if facts["givens"]:
+        required_roles.add("given")
+    if facts["unknowns"]:
+        required_roles.add("unknown")
+    if facts["visual_references"]:
+        required_roles.add("visual_reference")
+    if facts["official_mark_points"]:
+        required_roles.add("mark_point")
+    if facts["part_ownership"]:
+        required_roles.add("part_ownership")
+    actual_roles = {binding["semantic_role"] for binding in record["source_bindings"]}
+    require(
+        required_roles <= actual_roles,
+        "layer_a_fact_role_evidence_incomplete",
+    )
+

+def taxonomy_indexes(
+    taxonomy_document: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, set[str]], dict[str, str]]:
+    value = taxonomy_document or taxonomy()
+    family_types: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
+    type_family: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for family in value.get("families", []):
+        family_id = family.get("id")
+        require(isinstance(family_id, str), "taxonomy_family_id_invalid")
+        type_ids = {item.get("id") for item in family.get("types", [])}
+        require(
+            all(isinstance(item, str) for item in type_ids),
+            "taxonomy_type_id_invalid",
+        )
+        family_types[family_id] = type_ids
+        for type_id in type_ids:
+            assert isinstance(type_id, str)
+            require(type_id not in type_family, "taxonomy_type_id_duplicate")
+            type_family[type_id] = family_id
+    return family_types, type_family
+
+
+def receipt_payload_sha256(receipt: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    payload = {key: value for key, value in receipt.items() if key != "artifact_sha256"}
+    return sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(payload))
+
+
+def validate_authenticated_receipt(
+    receipt: dict[str, Any] | None, receipt_kind: str
+) -> None:
+    require(isinstance(receipt, dict), f"{receipt_kind}_receipt_missing")
+    assert receipt is not None
+    require(receipt.get("status") == "pass", f"{receipt_kind}_receipt_not_pass")
+    require(
+        receipt.get("artifact_sha256") == receipt_payload_sha256(receipt),
+        f"{receipt_kind}_receipt_hash_mismatch",
+    )
+
+
+def validate_semantic_approval(
+    record: dict[str, Any],
+    taxonomy_document: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+    *,
+    layer_a_authority: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+    semantic_authority_id: str | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    validate_against_shipped_schema("contracts/layer-b.schema.v1.json", record)
+    require(
+        record.get("state") == "approved_semantic",
+        "authoritative_semantic_state_not_approved",
+    )
+    evidence = record.get("review_evidence", {})
+    require(bool(evidence.get("independent_review_id")), "approved_semantic_review_missing")
+    require(bool(evidence.get("resolver_decision_id")), "approved_semantic_resolver_missing")
+    actors = [
+        evidence.get("maker_actor_id"),
+        evidence.get("checker_actor_id"),
+        evidence.get("resolver_actor_id"),
+    ]
+    require(all(isinstance(actor, str) and actor for actor in actors), "semantic_actor_custody_missing")
+    require(len(set(actors)) == 3, "semantic_actor_custody_not_distinct")
+    require(bool(record.get("evidence_rationale")), "approved_semantic_rationale_missing")
+    validate_role_typed_bindings(record["evidence_rationale"])
+    require(
+        all(
+            binding.get("semantic_role") == "semantic_rationale"
+            for binding in record["evidence_rationale"]
+        ),
+        "approved_semantic_rationale_role_invalid",
+    )
+    require(
+        record.get("taxonomy_version") == "9709-semantic-taxonomy-v0.1",
+        "approved_semantic_taxonomy_binding_invalid",
+    )
+    classification = record.get("classification", {})
+    require(
+        classification.get("uncertainty") in {"low", "medium"},
+        "approved_semantic_uncertainty_unresolved",
+    )
+    contradiction = classification.get("contradiction_posture", {})
+    require(
+        contradiction.get("status") == "resolved",
+        "approved_semantic_contradiction_unresolved",
+    )
+    contradiction_ids = contradiction.get("contradiction_ids", [])
+    resolution_refs = contradiction.get("resolution_refs", [])
+    require(
+        not contradiction_ids or bool(resolution_refs),
+        "approved_semantic_contradiction_resolution_missing",
+    )
+    family_types, type_family = taxonomy_indexes(taxonomy_document)
+    family_ref = classification.get("primary_family_ref")
+    type_ref = classification.get("primary_type_ref")
+    require(family_ref in family_types, "approved_semantic_family_ref_unknown")
+    require(
+        type_ref in family_types[family_ref],
+        "approved_semantic_type_family_mismatch",
+    )
+    multi_labels = classification.get("multi_label_refs", [])
+    require(
+        isinstance(multi_labels, list)
+        and len(multi_labels) == len(set(multi_labels))
+        and all(label in type_family for label in multi_labels),
+        "approved_semantic_multi_label_ref_unknown",
+    )
+    require(
+        type_ref not in multi_labels,
+        "approved_semantic_primary_repeated_as_secondary",
+    )
+    multi_label_evidence = classification.get("multi_label_evidence", [])
+    evidence_refs = [
+        item.get("type_ref")
+        for item in multi_label_evidence
+        if isinstance(item, dict)
+    ]
+    require(
+        len(evidence_refs) == len(multi_label_evidence)
+        and len(evidence_refs) == len(set(evidence_refs))
+        and set(evidence_refs) == set(multi_labels),
+        "approved_semantic_multi_label_evidence_set_mismatch",
+    )
+    for item in multi_label_evidence:
+        bindings = item.get("evidence_bindings", [])
+        validate_role_typed_bindings(bindings)
+        require(
+            all(
+                binding.get("semantic_role") == "semantic_rationale"
+                for binding in bindings
+            ),
+            "approved_semantic_multi_label_evidence_role_invalid",
+        )
+    require(layer_a_authority is not None, "approved_semantic_layer_a_authority_missing")
+    assert layer_a_authority is not None
+    layer_a_record = layer_a_authority.get("record")
+    require(isinstance(layer_a_record, dict), "approved_semantic_layer_a_record_missing")
+    assert isinstance(layer_a_record, dict)
+    validate_layer_a_verified(
+        layer_a_record,
+        layer_a_authority.get("structural_authority_records"),
+        layer_a_authority.get("source_authority_id"),
+        layer_a_authority.get("state_ledger"),
+    )
+    require(
+        layer_a_record.get("record_id") == record.get("layer_a_record_ref")
+        and layer_a_record.get("question_id") == record.get("question_id")
+        and layer_a_authority.get("artifact_sha256")
+        == sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(layer_a_record)),
+        "approved_semantic_layer_a_binding_mismatch",
+    )
+    require(
+        semantic_authority_id is not None,
+        "approved_semantic_authority_missing",
+    )
+    review_ledger, resolver_ledger, _ = load_rooted_approval_authority(
+        semantic_authority_id,
+        layer="layer_b",
+    )
+    review = review_ledger.get(evidence["independent_review_id"])
+    decision = resolver_ledger.get(evidence["resolver_decision_id"])
+    validate_authenticated_receipt(review, "approved_semantic_review")
+    validate_authenticated_receipt(decision, "approved_semantic_resolver")
+    assert review is not None and decision is not None
+    semantic_sha256 = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(record))
+    require(
+        review.get("independent_review_id") == evidence["independent_review_id"]
+        and review.get("record_id") == record["record_id"]
+        and review.get("question_id") == record["question_id"]
+        and review.get("layer_a_record_ref") == record["layer_a_record_ref"]
+        and review.get("semantic_record_sha256") == semantic_sha256
+        and review.get("maker_actor_id") == evidence["maker_actor_id"]
+        and review.get("checker_actor_id") == evidence["checker_actor_id"]
+        and review.get("reviewer_actor_id") == evidence["checker_actor_id"]
+        and review.get("reviewed_state") == "independently_reviewed",
+        "approved_semantic_review_authority_mismatch",
+    )
+    require(
+        decision.get("resolver_decision_id") == evidence["resolver_decision_id"]
+        and decision.get("independent_review_id") == evidence["independent_review_id"]
+        and decision.get("record_id") == record["record_id"]
+        and decision.get("question_id") == record["question_id"]
+        and decision.get("layer_a_record_ref") == record["layer_a_record_ref"]
+        and decision.get("semantic_record_sha256") == semantic_sha256
+        and decision.get("resolver_actor_id") == evidence["resolver_actor_id"]
+        and decision.get("decided_state") == "approved_semantic",
+        "approved_semantic_resolver_authority_mismatch",
+    )

+def procedure_semantic_authority_sha256(
+    exemplars: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    approved_semantic_records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> str:
+    bindings = []
+    for exemplar in sorted(
+        exemplars,
+        key=lambda item: item["approved_semantic_record_ref"],
+    ):
+        authority = approved_semantic_records[
+            exemplar["approved_semantic_record_ref"]
+        ]
+        semantic = authority["record"]
+        semantic_review = semantic["review_evidence"]
+        semantic_review_ledger, semantic_resolver_ledger, _ = (
+            load_rooted_approval_authority(
+                authority["semantic_authority_id"],
+                layer="layer_b",
+            )
+        )
+        bindings.append(
+            {
+                "approved_semantic_record_ref": exemplar[
+                    "approved_semantic_record_ref"
+                ],
+                "approved_semantic_sha256": exemplar[
+                    "approved_semantic_sha256"
+                ],
+                "semantic_review_receipt_sha256": semantic_review_ledger[
+                    semantic_review["independent_review_id"]
+                ][
+                    "artifact_sha256"
+                ],
+                "semantic_resolver_receipt_sha256": semantic_resolver_ledger[
+                    semantic_review["resolver_decision_id"]
+                ][
+                    "artifact_sha256"
+                ],
+                "layer_a_artifact_sha256": authority["layer_a_authority"][
+                    "artifact_sha256"
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+    return sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(bindings))
+

+def validate_procedure_model(
+    record: dict[str, Any],
+    approved_semantic_records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
+    taxonomy_document: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
+    *,
+    procedure_authority_id: str | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    validate_against_shipped_schema("contracts/layer-c.schema.v1.json", record)
+    require(record.get("scope") == "shared", "procedure_model_not_shared")
+    require(
+        "generated_for_question_id" not in record,
+        "question_singleton_procedure_factory_rejected",
+    )
+    require(
+        record.get("state") == "approved_procedure",
+        "authoritative_procedure_state_not_approved",
+    )
+    exemplars = record.get("applicability", {}).get("question_exemplar_refs", [])
+    exemplar_ids = [
+        item.get("question_id") for item in exemplars if isinstance(item, dict)

+    require(
+        len(exemplars) >= 2 and len(set(exemplar_ids)) >= 2,
+        "approved_procedure_requires_two_independent_exemplars",

+    review = record.get("review_evidence", {})
+    require(bool(review.get("procedure_review_id")), "approved_procedure_review_missing")
+    require(bool(review.get("resolver_decision_id")), "approved_procedure_resolver_missing")
+    actors = [
+        review.get("procedure_maker_actor_id"),
+        review.get("procedure_reviewer_actor_id"),
+        review.get("resolver_actor_id"),

+    require(all(isinstance(actor, str) and actor for actor in actors), "procedure_actor_custody_missing")
+    require(len(set(actors)) == 3, "procedure_actor_custody_not_distinct")
+    applicability = record.get("applicability", {})
+    _, type_family = taxonomy_indexes(taxonomy_document)
+    type_refs = applicability.get("question_type_refs", [])
+    require(
+        isinstance(type_refs, list)
+        and bool(type_refs)
+        and len(type_refs) == len(set(type_refs))
+        and all(item in type_family for item in type_refs),
+        "approved_procedure_type_ref_unknown",
+    )
+    require(
+        approved_semantic_records is not None,
+        "approved_procedure_exemplar_authority_missing",
+    )
+    assert approved_semantic_records is not None
+    for exemplar in exemplars:
+        require(isinstance(exemplar, dict), "approved_procedure_exemplar_shape_invalid")
+        semantic_ref = exemplar.get("approved_semantic_record_ref")
+        semantic_authority = approved_semantic_records.get(semantic_ref)

+            semantic_authority_id=semantic_authority.get(
+                "semantic_authority_id"
+            ),
+        )
+        require(
+            semantic.get("question_id") == exemplar.get("question_id"),
+            "approved_procedure_exemplar_question_mismatch",
+        )
+        require(
+            sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(semantic))
+            == exemplar.get("approved_semantic_sha256"),
+            "approved_procedure_exemplar_hash_mismatch",
+        )
+        primary_type = semantic.get("classification", {}).get("primary_type_ref")
+        require(
+            primary_type == exemplar.get("primary_type_ref")
+            and primary_type in type_refs,
+            "approved_procedure_exemplar_type_mismatch",
+        )
+    semantic_authority_sha256 = procedure_semantic_authority_sha256(
+        exemplars,
+        approved_semantic_records,

+        procedure_authority_id is not None,
+        "approved_procedure_authority_missing",

+            procedure_authority_id,
+            layer="layer_c",

+    review_receipt = procedure_review_ledger.get(review["procedure_review_id"])
+    resolver_receipt = procedure_resolver_ledger.get(
+        review["resolver_decision_id"]
+    )
+    validate_authenticated_receipt(
+        review_receipt, "approved_procedure_review"
+    )
+    validate_authenticated_receipt(
+        resolver_receipt, "approved_procedure_resolver"
+    )
+    assert review_receipt is not None and resolver_receipt is not None
+    procedure_sha256 = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(record))
+    require(
+        review_receipt.get("procedure_review_id")
+        == review["procedure_review_id"]
+        and review_receipt.get("procedure_model_id")
+        == record["procedure_model_id"]
+        and review_receipt.get("revision_id") == record["revision_id"]
+        and review_receipt.get("run_id") == record["run_id"]
+        and review_receipt.get("procedure_record_sha256") == procedure_sha256
+        and review_receipt.get("procedure_maker_actor_id")
+        == review["procedure_maker_actor_id"]
+        and review_receipt.get("procedure_reviewer_actor_id")
+        == review["procedure_reviewer_actor_id"]
+        and review_receipt.get("reviewed_state") == "procedure_reviewed"
+        and review_receipt.get("approved_semantic_authority_sha256")

+    require(
+        resolver_receipt.get("resolver_decision_id")

+        and resolver_receipt.get("procedure_review_id")
+        == review["procedure_review_id"]
+        and resolver_receipt.get("procedure_model_id")
+        == record["procedure_model_id"]
+        and resolver_receipt.get("revision_id") == record["revision_id"]
+        and resolver_receipt.get("run_id") == record["run_id"]
+        and resolver_receipt.get("procedure_record_sha256")
+        == procedure_sha256
+        and resolver_receipt.get("resolver_actor_id")
+        == review["resolver_actor_id"]
+        and resolver_receipt.get("decided_state") == "approved_procedure"
+        and resolver_receipt.get("approved_semantic_authority_sha256")
+        == semantic_authority_sha256,
+        "approved_procedure_resolver_authority_mismatch",
+    )
+    steps = record.get("procedure_steps", [])
+    step_ids = [item.get("step_id") for item in steps if isinstance(item, dict)]
+    require(
+        len(step_ids) == len(steps) and len(step_ids) == len(set(step_ids)),
+        "procedure_step_id_duplicate_or_missing",
+    )
+    step_set = set(step_ids)
+    for step in steps:
+        require(
+            set(step.get("preconditions", [])) <= step_set,
+            "procedure_step_precondition_ref_unknown",
+        )
+    skeleton = record.get("canonical_step_skeleton", {})
+    require(
+        skeleton.get("procedure_revision_ref") == record.get("revision_id"),
+        "procedure_skeleton_revision_mismatch",

+    require(
+        bool(skeleton.get("step_refs"))
+        and set(skeleton.get("step_refs", [])) <= step_set,
+        "procedure_skeleton_step_ref_unknown",
+    )
+    alternative_paths = record.get("alternative_paths", [])
+    path_ids = [
+        path.get("path_id") for path in alternative_paths if isinstance(path, dict)
+    ]
+    require(
+        len(path_ids) == len(alternative_paths)
+        and len(path_ids) == len(set(path_ids)),
+        "procedure_path_id_duplicate_or_missing",
+    )
+    for path in alternative_paths:
+        require(
+            bool(path.get("step_refs")) and set(path["step_refs"]) <= step_set,
+            "procedure_alternative_path_step_ref_unknown",
+        )
+    failure_points = record.get("failure_points", [])
+    failure_ids = [
+        failure.get("failure_point_id")
+        for failure in failure_points
+        if isinstance(failure, dict)
+    ]
+    require(
+        len(failure_ids) == len(failure_points)
+        and len(failure_ids) == len(set(failure_ids)),
+        "procedure_failure_point_id_duplicate_or_missing",
+    )
+    for failure in failure_points:
+        require(
+            failure.get("step_ref") in step_set,
+            "procedure_failure_point_step_ref_unknown",
+        )
+    mark_points = record.get("mark_points", [])
+    mark_ids = [
+        item.get("mark_point_id") for item in mark_points if isinstance(item, dict)
+    ]
+    require(
+        bool(mark_ids)
+        and len(mark_ids) == len(mark_points)
+        and len(mark_ids) == len(set(mark_ids)),
+        "procedure_mark_point_id_duplicate_or_missing",
+    )
+    for mark_point in mark_points:
+        validate_role_typed_bindings([mark_point["source_binding"]])
+        require(
+            mark_point["source_binding"].get("semantic_role")
+            == "mark_point",
+            "procedure_mark_point_source_role_invalid",
+        )
+    bindings = record.get("mark_point_step_bindings", [])
+    require(bool(bindings), "approved_procedure_mark_point_binding_missing")
+    bound_mark_ids: list[str] = []
+    for binding in bindings:
+        require(
+            binding.get("mark_point_ref") in set(mark_ids),
+            "procedure_binding_mark_point_ref_unknown",
+        )

+            binding.get("procedure_step_ref") in step_set,

+            binding["evidence_binding"].get("semantic_role")
+            == "mark_point_to_procedure_step",
+            "procedure_binding_role_invalid",
+        )
+        bound_mark_ids.append(binding["mark_point_ref"])
+    require(
+        len(bound_mark_ids) == len(set(bound_mark_ids))

+def validate_role_typed_bindings(bindings: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    require(bool(bindings), "source_binding_missing")
+    for binding in bindings:
+        for field in (
+            "binding_id",
+            "semantic_role",
+            "source_object_id",
+            "source_sha256",
+            "page_number",
+            "region_id",
+            "region_sha256",
+            "rationale",
+            "provenance",
+        ):
+            require(binding.get(field) not in (None, "", []), f"source_binding_field_missing:{field}")
+        require(
+            re.fullmatch(HEX64, binding["source_sha256"]) is not None,
+            "source_binding_source_hash_invalid",
+        )
+        require(
+            re.fullmatch(HEX64, binding["region_sha256"]) is not None,
+            "source_binding_region_hash_invalid",
+        )
+        provenance = binding.get("provenance")
+        require(
+            isinstance(provenance, dict),
+            "source_binding_provenance_invalid",
+        )
+        for field in ("run_id", "artifact_path", "artifact_sha256"):
+            require(
+                provenance.get(field) not in (None, "", []),
+                f"source_binding_provenance_field_missing:{field}",
+            )
+        artifact_path = Path(provenance["artifact_path"])
+        require(
+            not artifact_path.is_absolute() and ".." not in artifact_path.parts,
+            "source_binding_provenance_path_invalid",
+        )
+        require(
+            re.fullmatch(HEX64, provenance["artifact_sha256"]) is not None,
+            "source_binding_provenance_hash_invalid",
+        )
