+def validate_run_history(runs: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    by_id: dict[str, str] = {}
+    parents: dict[str, str | None] = {}
+    identity_hashes: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}
+    for run in runs:
+        run_id = run["run_id"]
+        digest = sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes({k: v for k, v in run.items() if k != "digest"}))
+        if run_id in by_id:
+            require(by_id[run_id] == digest, "immutable_run_mutation_rejected")
+        by_id[run_id] = digest
+        parents[run_id] = run.get("supersedes_run_id")
+        require(
+            run.get("mutation_policy") == "append_only_no_historical_overwrite",
+            "run_mutation_policy_invalid",
+        )
+        records = run.get("records")
+        require(isinstance(records, list), "run_records_invalid")
+        for record in records:
+            require(isinstance(record, dict), "run_record_invalid")
+            record_id = record.get("record_id")
+            content_hash = record.get("content_sha256")
+            require(
+                isinstance(record_id, str) and bool(record_id),
+                "run_record_id_missing",
+            )
+            require(
+                isinstance(content_hash, str)
+                and re.fullmatch(HEX64, content_hash) is not None,
+                "run_record_content_hash_invalid",
+            )
+            identities = [("record_id", record_id)]
+            revision_id = record.get("revision_id")
+            if revision_id is not None:
+                require(
+                    isinstance(revision_id, str) and bool(revision_id),
+                    "run_revision_id_invalid",
+                )
+                identities.append(("revision_id", revision_id))
+            for identity in identities:
+                if identity in identity_hashes:
+                    require(
+                        identity_hashes[identity] == content_hash,
+                        f"immutable_record_or_revision_mutation_rejected:{identity[0]}",
+                    )
+                identity_hashes[identity] = content_hash
+    for run_id, parent in parents.items():
+        if parent is None:
+            continue
+        require(parent in parents, "supersession_predecessor_missing")
+        seen = {run_id}
+        cursor: str | None = parent
+        while cursor is not None:
+            require(cursor not in seen, "supersession_cycle")
+            seen.add(cursor)
+            cursor = parents.get(cursor)
+

+def validate_preview_readback(
+    record: dict[str, Any], authoritative_expected: dict[str, Any]
+) -> None:
+    require(
+        isinstance(authoritative_expected, dict) and bool(authoritative_expected),
+        "preview_authoritative_expected_missing",
+    )
+    for field in (
+        "question_id",
+        "source_semantic_revision_ref",
+        "taxonomy_version",
+        "method_map",
+        "copilot_citations",
+        "stale_reference_count",
+    ):
+        require(
+            field in authoritative_expected,
+            f"preview_authoritative_expected_field_missing:{field}",
+        )
+    require(
+        record.get("taxonomy_version") == "9709-semantic-taxonomy-v0.1",
+        "preview_taxonomy_version_stale",
+    )
+    require(
+        record.get("question_id") == authoritative_expected["question_id"]
+        and record.get("source_semantic_revision_ref")
+        == authoritative_expected["source_semantic_revision_ref"]
+        and record.get("taxonomy_version")
+        == authoritative_expected["taxonomy_version"],
+        "preview_semantic_authority_mismatch",
+    )
+    require(
+        record.get("method_map") == authoritative_expected["method_map"],
+        "preview_method_map_authority_mismatch",
+    )
+    require(
+        record.get("copilot_citations")
+        == authoritative_expected["copilot_citations"],
+        "preview_citation_authority_mismatch",
+    )
+    readback = record.get("readback", {})
+    require(
+        authoritative_expected["stale_reference_count"] == 0
+        and readback.get("stale_reference_count")
+        == authoritative_expected["stale_reference_count"],
+        "preview_stale_reference_rejected",
+    )
+    isolation = record.get("isolation", {})
+    require(isolation.get("artifact_only") is True, "preview_not_artifact_only")
+    require(
+        isolation.get("structural_write_count") == 0,
+        "preview_structural_write_rejected",
+    )
+    require(
+        isolation.get("downstream_write_count") == 0,
+        "preview_downstream_write_rejected",
+    )
+    require(
+        isolation.get("failure_mutates_structural_truth") is False,
+        "preview_failure_mutation_rejected",
+    )
+    expected_input = sha256_bytes(
+        canonical_bytes(
+            {
+                "question_id": authoritative_expected["question_id"],
+                "semantic_revision": authoritative_expected[
+                    "source_semantic_revision_ref"
+                ],
+                "taxonomy_version": authoritative_expected["taxonomy_version"],
+            }
+        )
+    )
+    expected_render = sha256_bytes(
+        canonical_bytes(authoritative_expected["method_map"])
+    )
+    expected_citations = sha256_bytes(
+        canonical_bytes(authoritative_expected["copilot_citations"])
+    )
+    require(readback.get("input_sha256") == expected_input, "preview_input_hash_drift")
+    require(
+        readback.get("render_sha256") == expected_render,
+        "preview_render_hash_drift",
+    )
+    require(
+        readback.get("citation_sha256") == expected_citations,
+        "preview_citation_hash_drift",
+    )

+def build_candidate_rows() -> tuple[
+    dict[str, dict[str, Any]],

+    structural = load_json(STRUCTURAL_CORPUS)

+    text = load_json(TEXT_HINTS)
+    require(structural.get("verified_count") == 3497, "structural_verified_count_drift")
+    require(len(structural.get("rows", [])) == 3497, "structural_row_count_drift")
+    require(safe.get("count") == 36, "safe_rejection_count_drift")
+    require(len(safe.get("rows", [])) == 36, "safe_rejection_rows_drift")
+    require(
+        structural.get("allowed_states") == ["resolver_verified", "verified_agreement"],
+        "structural_allowed_states_drift",
+    )
+    eligible: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for row in structural["rows"]:
+        qid = row["question_id"]
+        require(qid not in eligible, "duplicate_structural_question")
+        require(
+            row["question"]["verification_state"] in structural["allowed_states"],
+            "ineligible_structural_state",
+        )
+        eligible[qid] = row
+    rejected = {row["question_id"] for row in safe["rows"]}
+    require(not rejected & set(eligible), "safe_rejection_readmitted")
+    papers = {row["paper_id"]: row for row in paper_ledger["rows"]}
+    require(len(papers) == 432, "paper_ledger_count_drift")
+    hints: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    for item in text["items"]:
+        qid = qid_from_text_item(item)
+        if qid not in eligible:
+            continue
+        paper_id = eligible[qid]["question"]["paper_id"]
+        require(paper_id in papers, "eligible_paper_missing")
+        require(
+            item["source_pdf"] in {
+                papers[paper_id]["qp"]["source_path"],
+                str(papers[paper_id]["qp"]["source_path"]).replace(
+                    "data/past-papers/", "data/past-papers/"
+                ),
+            },
+            "text_hint_paper_binding_drift",
+        )
+        hints[qid] = item
+    return eligible, hints, rejected, {
+        "structural_corpus_sha256": sha256_file(STRUCTURAL_CORPUS),
+        "structural_question_ledger_sha256": sha256_file(STRUCTURAL_QUESTION_LEDGER),
+        "structural_paper_ledger_sha256": sha256_file(STRUCTURAL_PAPER_LEDGER),
+        "safe_rejection_queue_sha256": sha256_file(STRUCTURAL_SAFE_REJECTIONS),
+        "topic_hint_registry_sha256": sha256_file(TEXT_HINTS),
+        "eligible_count": len(eligible),
+        "topic_hint_joined_eligible_count": len(hints),
+        "safe_rejection_count": len(rejected),
+    }
+
+
+def candidate_descriptor(
+    family: str, qid: str, row: dict[str, Any], hint: dict[str, Any]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    question = row["question"]
+    paper_id = question["paper_id"]
+    meta = paper_metadata(paper_id)
+    pages = question["complete_page_chain"]
+    regions = question["authoritative_regions"]
+    normalized_text = hint.get("normalized_plain_text", "")
+    explicit_alternative = bool(
+        re.search(
+            r"\bor otherwise\b|\bor by another method\b|\balternative method\b",
+            normalized_text,
+            re.IGNORECASE,
+        )
+    )
+    linked_method = bool(
+        re.search(
+            r"\bshow that\b|\bprove that\b|\bhence\b|\busing the substitution\b",
+            normalized_text,
+            re.IGNORECASE,
+        )
+    )
+    boundary_patterns = {
+        "Integration Techniques": (
+            r"dy/dx|\\frac\{\\mathrm\{d\}y\}|"
+            r"\barea\b|\bvolume\b|\bsin\b|\bcos\b|\btan\b"
+        ),
+        "Differential Equations": (
+            r"\btank\b|\bpopulation\b|\bproportion|\brate\b|\bmodel\b|"
+            r"\bwhen x\b|\bwhen t\b|\bwhen y\b"
+        ),
+        "Trigonometric Manipulation / Equations": (
+            r"\bshow that\b|\bprove\b|\btriangle\b|\bidentity\b|"
+            r"\bdifferentiat|\bintegrat"
+        ),
+    }
+    boundary_candidate = bool(
+        re.search(boundary_patterns.get(family, r"$a"), normalized_text, re.IGNORECASE)
+    )
+    require(bool(regions), "selected_question_authoritative_regions_missing")
+    return {
+        "question_id": qid,
+        "paper_id": paper_id,
+        "family_reservation": family,
+        "topic_hint": hint["primary_topic_path"],
+        "topic_hint_role": "selection_only_not_semantic_approval",
+        "structural_verification_state": question["verification_state"],
+        "structural_record_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(row)),
+        "source_binding_summary": [
+            {
+                "semantic_role": "structural_selection_authority",
+                "source_object_id": region["source_object_id"],
+                "source_sha256": region["source_sha256"],
+                "page_number": region["page_number"],
+                "region_id": region["region_id"],
+                "region_sha256": region["crop_sha256"],
+            }
+            for region in regions
+        ],
+        "selection_facets": {
+            **meta,
+            "era": era(meta["year"]),
+            "page_shape": "cross_page" if len(pages) > 1 else "single_page",
+            "layout_family": question["layout_family"],
+        },
+        "reservation_hints": {
+            "hint_role": "selection_only_stage_2_must_independently_confirm",
+            "explicit_alternative_wording": explicit_alternative,
+            "alternative_path_review_candidate": explicit_alternative
+            or linked_method,
+            "single_path_review_candidate": not (explicit_alternative or linked_method),
+            "taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate": boundary_candidate,
+        },
+        "semantic_processing_executed": False,
+    }
+
+
+def core_candidates(
+    eligible: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], hints: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]
+) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    result: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {family: [] for family in FAMILIES}
+    for qid, hint in hints.items():
+        for family, topic_paths in FAMILY_TOPIC_HINTS.items():
+            if hint["primary_topic_path"] in topic_paths:
+                result[family].append(candidate_descriptor(family, qid, eligible[qid], hint))
+    return result

+def ranked(
+    candidates: Iterable[dict[str, Any]], seed: str, label: str
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    return sorted(
+        candidates,
+        key=lambda row: (
+            stable_score(seed, label, row["question_id"]),
+            row["question_id"],
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def select_family(
+    candidates: list[dict[str, Any]],
+    count: int,
+    seed: str,
+    label: str,
+    used_papers: set[str],
+    coverage: bool,
+    preferred_papers: set[str] | None = None,
+) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    available = [
+        row
+        for row in ranked(candidates, seed, label)
+        if row["paper_id"] not in used_papers
+    ]
+    preferred_papers = preferred_papers or set()
+    available.sort(
+        key=lambda row: (
+            0 if row["paper_id"] in preferred_papers else 1,
+            stable_score(seed, label, row["question_id"]),
+            row["question_id"],
+        )
+    )
+    selected: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def take(predicate: Any, code: str) -> None:
+        for row in available:
+            if row in selected or row["paper_id"] in used_papers:
+                continue
+            if predicate(row):
+                selected.append(row)
+                used_papers.add(row["paper_id"])
+                return
+        raise ContractError(f"insufficient_coverage:{label}:{code}")
+
+    if coverage:
+        for session in ("m", "s", "w"):
+            take(
+                lambda row, value=session: row["selection_facets"]["session"] == value,
+                f"session_{session}",
+            )
+        for era_name in ("2016_2018", "2019_2022", "2023_2025"):
+            take(
+                lambda row, value=era_name: row["selection_facets"]["era"] == value,
+                f"era_{era_name}",
+            )
+        for shape in ("single_page", "cross_page"):
+            take(
+                lambda row, value=shape: row["selection_facets"]["page_shape"] == value,
+                f"page_shape_{shape}",
+            )
+        for index in range(2):
+            take(
+                lambda row: row["reservation_hints"][
+                    "alternative_path_review_candidate"
+                ],
+                f"alternative_path_review_candidate_{index + 1}",
+            )
+        for index in range(2):
+            take(
+                lambda row: row["reservation_hints"]["single_path_review_candidate"],
+                f"single_path_review_candidate_{index + 1}",
+            )
+        for index in range(2):
+            take(
+                lambda row: row["reservation_hints"][
+                    "taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate"
+                ],
+                f"taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate_{index + 1}",
+            )
+        if label != "Differential Equations":
+            for paper in (1, 3):
+                take(
+                    lambda row, value=paper: row["selection_facets"]["paper"] == value,
+                    f"paper_{paper}",
+                )
+    for row in available:
+        if len(selected) == count:
+            break
+        if row in selected or row["paper_id"] in used_papers:
+            continue
+        selected.append(row)
+        used_papers.add(row["paper_id"])
+    require(len(selected) == count, f"insufficient_family_count:{label}")
+    return sorted(selected, key=lambda row: row["question_id"])
+
+
+def build_walking(
+    candidates: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]], used_papers: set[str]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    members: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    partition_papers: set[str] = set()
+    for family in SELECTION_ORDER:
+        family_papers = set(used_papers)
+        chosen = select_family(
+            candidates[family],
+            16,
+            "issue-1701-selection-v1",
+            family,
+            family_papers,
+            coverage=True,
+            preferred_papers=partition_papers,
+        )
+        members.extend(chosen)
+        partition_papers.update(row["paper_id"] for row in chosen)
+    used_papers.update(row["paper_id"] for row in members)
+    coverage = coverage_summary(members)
+    return {
+        "schema_version": "9709_semantic_walking_selection.v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "partition": "walking",
+        "status": "membership_frozen_execution_denied",
+        "semantic_processing_executed": False,
+        "member_count": len(members),
+        "family_counts": dict(sorted(Counter(row["family_reservation"] for row in members).items())),
+        "members": sorted(members, key=lambda row: (row["family_reservation"], row["question_id"])),
+        "coverage": coverage,
+        "selection_hint_non_claim": (
+            "Family reservations use pre-existing topic hints for stratification only; "
+            "Stage 2 must independently review every semantic classification."
+        ),
+    }
+

+def stress_candidates(
+    eligible: dict[str, dict[str, Any]], hints: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]
+) -> dict[int, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
+    result: dict[int, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {4: [], 5: [], 6: []}
+    for qid, hint in hints.items():
+        paper = int(hint["paper"])
+        if paper not in result:
+            continue
+        row = candidate_descriptor(
+            f"adapter_stress_p{paper}", qid, eligible[qid], hint
+        )
+        row["allowed_terminal_posture"] = [
+            "taxonomy_review_required",
+            "adapter_extension_required",
+            "out_of_current_scope",
+        ]
+        result[paper].append(row)
+    return result

+def ensure_private_key(private_root: Path) -> tuple[Path, bytes]:
+    private_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    os.chmod(private_root, 0o700)
+    key_path = private_root / "sealed-holdout-hmac.key"
+    if key_path.exists():
+        mode = stat.S_IMODE(key_path.stat().st_mode)
+        require(mode == 0o600, "sealed_key_permissions_invalid")
+        key = key_path.read_bytes()
+        require(len(key) == 32, "sealed_key_length_invalid")
+        return key_path, key
+    key = secrets.token_bytes(32)
+    descriptor = os.open(key_path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_WRONLY, 0o600)
+    with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as handle:
+        handle.write(key)
+        handle.flush()
+        os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+    return key_path, key
+
+

+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "partition": "sealed_holdout",

+            {
+                "question_id": row["question_id"],
+                "paper_id": row["paper_id"],
+                "family_reservation": row["family_reservation"],
+                "structural_record_sha256": row["structural_record_sha256"],
+            }
+            for row in sorted(

+    }

+def build_sealed(
+    candidates: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]],
+    used_papers: set[str],
+    private_root: Path,
+    public_partitions: dict[str, tuple[set[str], set[str]]] | None = None,
+) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]:
+    key_path, key = ensure_private_key(private_root)
+    private_ranking_seed = hmac.new(
+        key,
+        b"issue-1701-sealed-membership-ranking-v2",
+        hashlib.sha256,
+    ).hexdigest()
+    members: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    partition_papers: set[str] = set()
+    for family in SELECTION_ORDER:
+        family_papers = set(used_papers)
+        chosen = select_family(
+            candidates[family],
+            16,
+            private_ranking_seed,
+            f"sealed:{family}",
+            family_papers,
+            coverage=False,
+            preferred_papers=partition_papers,
+        )
+        members.extend(chosen)
+        partition_papers.update(row["paper_id"] for row in chosen)
+    used_papers.update(row["paper_id"] for row in members)
+    private_payload = private_membership_payload(members)
+    private_path = private_root / "sealed-holdout-membership.v1.json"
+    write_json(private_path, private_payload, 0o600)
+    private_bytes = canonical_bytes(private_payload)
+    membership_hmac = hmac.new(key, private_bytes, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
+    membership_sha256 = sha256_bytes(private_bytes)
+    question_tokens = sorted(
+        hmac.new(key, row["question_id"].encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
+        for row in members
+    )
+    paper_tokens = sorted(
+        hmac.new(key, row["paper_id"].encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
+        for row in members
+    )
+    family_counts = dict(
+        sorted(Counter(row["family_reservation"] for row in members).items())
+    )
+    question_root = merkle_root(question_tokens)
+    paper_root = merkle_root(paper_tokens)
+    key_id = sha256_bytes(key)
+    custody_envelope = {
+        "membership_hmac_sha256": membership_hmac,
+        "membership_sha256": membership_sha256,
+        "membership_byte_length": len(private_bytes),
+        "member_count": len(members),
+        "family_counts": family_counts,
+        "question_token_merkle_root": question_root,
+        "paper_token_merkle_root": paper_root,
+        "key_id_sha256": key_id,
+    }
+    custody_envelope_hmac = hmac.new(
+        key, canonical_bytes(custody_envelope), hashlib.sha256
+    ).hexdigest()
+    commitment = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_semantic_sealed_holdout_commitment.v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "partition": "sealed_holdout",
+        "status": "membership_created_hashed_and_sealed_execution_denied",
+        "member_count": len(members),
+        "family_counts": family_counts,
+        "membership_disclosed": False,
+        "membership_inspected": False,
+        "semantic_processing_executed": False,
+        "commitment": {
+            "algorithm": "HMAC-SHA-256",
+            "membership_ranking": "HMAC-SHA-256-with-private-custody-key",
+            "membership_hmac_sha256": membership_hmac,
+            "membership_sha256": membership_sha256,
+            "membership_byte_length": len(private_bytes),
+            "question_token_merkle_root": question_root,
+            "paper_token_merkle_root": paper_root,
+            "key_id_sha256": key_id,
+            "custody_envelope_hmac_sha256": custody_envelope_hmac,
+            "key_committed_to_git": False,
+            "plaintext_committed_to_git": False,
+        },
+        "authorization": {
+            "required": "explicit_owner_authorization_after_calibration_and_final_freeze",
+            "reveal_allowed": False,
+            "inspect_allowed": False,
+            "process_allowed": False,
+            "tune_allowed": False,
+            "execute_allowed": False,
+        },
+    }
+    creation_overlap_counts = {
+        "walking_sealed_question_overlap": 0,
+        "walking_sealed_paper_overlap": 0,
+        "calibration_sealed_question_overlap": 0,
+        "calibration_sealed_paper_overlap": 0,
+    }
+    if public_partitions is not None:
+        sealed_question_ids = {row["question_id"] for row in members}
+        sealed_paper_ids = {row["paper_id"] for row in members}
+        for partition in ("walking", "calibration"):
+            public_question_ids, public_paper_ids = public_partitions[partition]
+            creation_overlap_counts[
+                f"{partition}_sealed_question_overlap"
+            ] = len(public_question_ids & sealed_question_ids)
+            creation_overlap_counts[
+                f"{partition}_sealed_paper_overlap"
+            ] = len(public_paper_ids & sealed_paper_ids)
+    require(
+        all(value == 0 for value in creation_overlap_counts.values()),
+        "sealed_creation_partition_group_leakage",
+    )
+    creation_proof = {
+        "overlap_counts": creation_overlap_counts,
+        "safe_rejection_membership_count": 0,
+        "ineligible_membership_count": 0,
+        "proof_scope": "creation_time_aggregate_only_no_member_content",
+    }
+    commitment["creation_proof"] = creation_proof
+    custody_envelope["creation_proof"] = creation_proof
+    commitment["commitment"]["custody_envelope_hmac_sha256"] = hmac.new(
+        key, canonical_bytes(custody_envelope), hashlib.sha256
+    ).hexdigest()
+    private_receipt = {
+        "private_path": str(private_path),
+        "key_path": str(key_path),
+        "member_count": len(members),
+        "family_counts": family_counts,
+        "membership_hmac_sha256": membership_hmac,
+        "membership_sha256": membership_sha256,
+        "membership_byte_length": len(private_bytes),
+        "creation_overlap_counts": creation_overlap_counts,
+        "safe_rejection_membership_count": 0,
+        "ineligible_membership_count": 0,
+        "membership_content_retained": False,
+    }
+    return commitment, private_receipt
+

+def merkle_root(tokens: list[str]) -> str:
+    require(bool(tokens), "merkle_tree_empty")
+    level = [bytes.fromhex(token) for token in tokens]
+    while len(level) > 1:
+        if len(level) % 2:
+            level.append(level[-1])
+        level = [
+            hashlib.sha256(level[index] + level[index + 1]).digest()
+            for index in range(0, len(level), 2)
+        ]
+    return level[0].hex()
+

+        rows = [row for row in members if row["family_reservation"] == family]
+        facets = [row["selection_facets"] for row in rows]
+        by_family[family] = {
+            "count": len(rows),
+            "papers": sorted({f"P{item['paper']}" for item in facets}),
+            "sessions": sorted({item["session"] for item in facets}),
+            "eras": sorted({item["era"] for item in facets}),
+            "page_shapes": sorted({item["page_shape"] for item in facets}),
+            "alternative_path_review_candidate_count": sum(
+                bool(row["reservation_hints"]["alternative_path_review_candidate"])
+                for row in rows
+            ),
+            "single_path_review_candidate_count": sum(
+                bool(row["reservation_hints"]["single_path_review_candidate"])
+                for row in rows
+            ),
+            "taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate_count": sum(
+                bool(row["reservation_hints"]["taxonomy_boundary_review_candidate"])
+                for row in rows

+            "explicit_alternative_wording_count": sum(
+                bool(row["reservation_hints"]["explicit_alternative_wording"])
+                for row in rows

+        "by_family": by_family,
+        "overall": {
+            "papers": sorted(
+                {f"P{row['selection_facets']['paper']}" for row in members}
+            ),
+            "sessions": sorted(
+                {row["selection_facets"]["session"] for row in members}
+            ),
+            "eras": sorted({row["selection_facets"]["era"] for row in members}),

+def taxonomy() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    def rule(
+        identifier: str,
+        name: str,

+        include: list[str],
+        exclude: list[str],
+        positives: list[str],
+        counterexamples: list[str],

+            "id": identifier,

+            "inclusion_rules": include,
+            "exclusion_rules": exclude,
+            "positive_examples": positives,
+            "counterexamples": counterexamples,
+            "boundary_cases": boundaries,
+        }
+
+    families = [
+        {
+            **rule(
+                "9709.family.integration_techniques",
+                "Integration Techniques",
+                "Questions whose principal demand is selecting and carrying out an integration technique, including exact evaluation and recovery of constants.",
+                [
+                    "The mark-bearing work requires constructing or evaluating an antiderivative.",

+                ],
+                [
+                    "Numerical integration where no symbolic antiderivative is required.",
+                    "Differentiation-only questions.",

+                [

+def validate_contract_documents(documents: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    required = set(contract_documents())
+    require(set(documents) == required, "contract_document_set_mismatch")
+    tax = documents["contracts/taxonomy.v0.1.json"]
+    families = tax.get("families", [])
+    require(
+        [item.get("name") for item in families] == list(FAMILIES),
+        "taxonomy_family_set_or_order_invalid",
+    )
+    for family in families:
+        for item in [family, *family.get("types", [])]:
+            for field in (
+                "definition",
+                "inclusion_rules",
+                "exclusion_rules",
+                "positive_examples",
+                "counterexamples",
+                "boundary_cases",
+            ):
+                value = item.get(field)
+                require(
+                    (isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip()))
+                    or (
+                        isinstance(value, list)
+                        and bool(value)
+                        and all(isinstance(entry, str) and entry.strip() for entry in value)
+                    ),
+                    f"taxonomy_required_field_invalid:{item.get('id')}:{field}",
+                )
+    machines = documents["contracts/independent-state-machines.v1.json"]["machines"]
+    require(set(machines) == {"layer_a", "layer_b", "layer_c"}, "state_machine_set_invalid")
+    state_sets = [set(machine["states"]) for machine in machines.values()]
+    require(
+        not state_sets[0] & state_sets[1]
+        and not state_sets[0] & state_sets[2]
+        and not state_sets[1] & state_sets[2],
+        "layer_state_names_not_independent",
+    )
+    require(
+        machines["layer_b"]["agreement_transition"] is None,
+        "agreement_transition_must_be_impossible",
+    )
+    require(
+        documents["contracts/math-9709-adapter.v1.json"]["layer_c_extensions"][
+            "question_level_singleton_factory"
+        ]
+        is False,
+        "question_singleton_factory_enabled",
+    )
+    for name, schema in schema_documents().items():
+        require(schema.get("$schema") == SCHEMA, f"json_schema_draft_missing:{name}")
+        require(schema.get("type") == "object", f"json_schema_root_invalid:{name}")
+        pending: list[Any] = [schema]
+        while pending:
+            value = pending.pop()
+            if isinstance(value, dict):
+                reference = value.get("$ref")
+                if isinstance(reference, str) and not reference.startswith(
+                    ("http://", "https://", "#")
+                ):
+                    target = (Path(name).parent / reference).as_posix()
+                    require(
+                        target in documents,
+                        f"json_schema_relative_ref_unresolved:{name}:{reference}",
+                    )
+                pending.extend(value.values())
+            elif isinstance(value, list):
+                pending.extend(value)
+

+def validate_transition(
+    machines: dict[str, Any],
+    layer: str,
+    source: str,
+    target: str,
+    evidence: Iterable[str] | dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
+) -> None:
+    require(layer in machines, "transition_layer_unknown")
+    machine = machines[layer]
+    require(source in machine["states"], "transition_source_unknown")
+    require(target in machine["states"], "transition_target_unknown")
+    require(target in machine["transitions"][source], "transition_not_allowed")
+    required = set(machine.get("approval_evidence", {}).get(target, []))
+    evidence_names = set(evidence)
+    require(required <= evidence_names, "transition_approval_evidence_missing")
+    if required:
+        require(
+            isinstance(evidence, dict),
+            "transition_evidence_not_authenticated",
+        )
+        for name in required:
+            receipt = evidence[name]
+            require(
+                isinstance(receipt, dict)
+                and receipt.get("status") == "pass"
+                and re.fullmatch(HEX64, receipt.get("artifact_sha256", ""))
+                is not None,
+                f"transition_evidence_receipt_invalid:{name}",
+            )

+def validate_against_shipped_schema(
+    schema_path: str, record: dict[str, Any]
+) -> None:
+    schemas = schema_documents()
+    require(schema_path in schemas, "shipped_schema_unknown")
+    registry = {Path(path).name: schema for path, schema in schemas.items()}
+    schema = schemas[schema_path]
+    resolver = RefResolver(base_uri="", referrer=schema, store=registry)
+    validator = Draft202012Validator(schema, resolver=resolver)
+    errors = sorted(
+        validator.iter_errors(record),
+        key=lambda error: tuple(str(part) for part in error.absolute_path),
+    )
+    if errors:
+        first = errors[0]
+        location = ".".join(str(part) for part in first.absolute_path) or "<root>"
+        raise ContractError(
+            f"shipped_schema_validation_failed:{schema_path}:{location}:{first.validator}"
+        )

+def load_pinned_root_registry(
+    filename: str,
+    expected_sha256: str,
+    authority_kind: str,
+) -> tuple[Path, Path, dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Load a checked-in trust anchor without consulting mutable path globals."""
+    module_repo = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+    root_path = (
+        Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "fixtures" / filename
+    ).resolve()
+    expected_path = (
+        module_repo / "scripts" / "vlm" / "fixtures" / filename
+    ).resolve()
+    require(
+        root_path == expected_path,
+        f"{authority_kind}_root_registry_path_substitution",
+    )
+    require(
+        root_path.is_file(),
+        f"{authority_kind}_root_registry_missing",
+    )
+    require(
+        sha256_file(root_path) == expected_sha256,
+        f"{authority_kind}_root_registry_pinned_hash_mismatch",
+    )
+    return module_repo, root_path, load_json(root_path)

+@functools.lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def _layer_a_structural_state_authority_bytes() -> tuple[
+    tuple[tuple[str, bytes, str], ...],
+    tuple[tuple[str, bytes, tuple[str, ...]], ...],
+    bytes,
+]:
+    module_repo, root_path, roots = load_pinned_root_registry(
+        "issue_1701_layer_a_structural_state_authority_roots.v1.json",
+        "d29ef645a795bb67c0877824ef60e25ba825fce63e431450e5bb2fa56d15dc46",

+        roots.get("status") == "frozen"
+        and roots.get("mutation_policy") == "additive_authority_roots_only",
+        "layer_a_structural_state_authority_roots_not_frozen",
+    )
+    matches = [
+        item
+        for item in roots.get("authorities", [])
+        if item.get("authority_id") == LAYER_A_STRUCTURAL_STATE_AUTHORITY_ID
+    ]
+    require(
+        len(matches) == 1,
+        "layer_a_structural_state_authority_root_missing_or_duplicate",
+    )
+    root = matches[0]
+    require(
+        root.get("status") == "immutable_contract_authority",
+        "layer_a_structural_state_authority_root_not_immutable",
+    )
+
+    def rooted_path(field: str, error: str) -> Path:
+        relative = Path(root[field])
+        require(
+            not relative.is_absolute() and ".." not in relative.parts,
+            f"{error}_path_invalid",
+        )
+        path = (module_repo / relative).resolve()
+        require(path.is_relative_to(module_repo), f"{error}_path_escape")
+        require(path.is_file(), f"{error}_missing")
+        return path
+
+    corpus_path = rooted_path(
+        "structural_corpus_path",
+        "layer_a_structural_corpus",
+    )
+    require(
+        sha256_file(corpus_path) == root.get("structural_corpus_sha256"),
+        "layer_a_structural_corpus_hash_mismatch",
+    )
+    corpus = load_json(corpus_path)
+    rows = corpus.get("rows")
+    require(
+        isinstance(rows, list)
+        and corpus.get("verified_count")
+        == root.get("structural_verified_count")
+        == len(rows)
+        == 3497,
+        "layer_a_structural_corpus_count_mismatch",
+    )
+    structural_entries = []
+    seen_questions: set[str] = set()
+    for row in rows:
+        require(isinstance(row, dict), "layer_a_structural_row_invalid")
+        question_id = row.get("question_id")
+        state = row.get("question", {}).get("verification_state")
+        require(
+            isinstance(question_id, str)
+            and question_id not in seen_questions
+            and state in {"resolver_verified", "verified_agreement"},
+            "layer_a_structural_row_identity_or_state_invalid",
+        )
+        seen_questions.add(question_id)
+        structural_entries.append(
+            (question_id, canonical_bytes(row), state)
+        )
+
+    state_path = rooted_path(
+        "state_ledger_path",
+        "layer_a_state_ledger",
+    )
+    require(
+        sha256_file(state_path) == root.get("state_ledger_sha256"),
+        "layer_a_state_ledger_hash_mismatch",
+    )
+    state_document = load_json(state_path)
+    require(
+        state_document.get("authority_id")
+        == LAYER_A_STRUCTURAL_STATE_AUTHORITY_ID
+        and state_document.get("status")
+        == "immutable_layer_a_record_state_authority"
+        and state_document.get("mutation_policy")
+        == "immutable_additive_supersession_only",
+        "layer_a_state_ledger_identity_invalid",
+    )
+    state_entries = []
+    for record_id, entry in state_document.get("records", {}).items():
+        record = entry.get("record")
+        history = entry.get("state_history")
+        require(
+            isinstance(record_id, str)
+            and isinstance(record, dict)
+            and record.get("record_id") == record_id
+            and isinstance(history, list)
+            and history
+            == ["source_candidate", "source_checked", "source_verified"]
+            and entry.get("artifact_sha256")
+            == sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(record)),
+            "layer_a_state_ledger_entry_invalid",
+        )
+        state_entries.append(
+            (record_id, canonical_bytes(record), tuple(history))
+        )
+    require(bool(state_entries), "layer_a_state_ledger_empty")
+    receipt = {
+        "authority_id": LAYER_A_STRUCTURAL_STATE_AUTHORITY_ID,
+        "root_registry_path": root_path.relative_to(module_repo).as_posix(),
+        "root_registry_sha256": sha256_file(root_path),
+        "structural_corpus_path": root["structural_corpus_path"],
+        "structural_corpus_sha256": root["structural_corpus_sha256"],
+        "structural_verified_count": len(structural_entries),
+        "state_ledger_path": root["state_ledger_path"],
+        "state_ledger_sha256": root["state_ledger_sha256"],
+        "layer_a_record_count": len(state_entries),
+        "independently_loaded": True,
+    }
+    return (
+        tuple(structural_entries),
+        tuple(state_entries),
+        canonical_bytes(receipt),
+    )

The new exact regression first populates the cached Layer A/taxonomy loaders, then substitutes tampered bytes only on the reopened taxonomy export read; publication fails closed with `taxonomy_authority_export_document_hash_mismatch`.
